Title: Full Stack Data Scientist
Description:
Are you a Full Stack Data Scientist driven by turning data into tangible business results? Do you want to help organizations become more productive and competitive?

Vuono Group is now looking for Full Stack Data Scientists to join our growing team of experts in Helsinki. Vuono Group is a consultancy that drives business value with processes and AI. We empower Nordic organisations in both the private and public sectors to bridge the gap between business needs and AI capabilities, enabling smarter decision-making, increased operational efficiency, and accelerated growth.

About The Role

As a Full Stack Data Scientist, you are interested in what happens under the hood of modern data solutions and data architectures. You care about data quality, usability and the value it can provide for various business processes. You're experienced with data science and engineering practices, including data observability, implementing MLOps (maybe even LLMOps) workflows and real-time data processing. You understand the intersection of ML/AI systems and data engineering and can build scalable pipelines that support both analytical and operational use cases. Experience with cloud-native data architectures (e.g. Azure, AWS, GCP) is essential.

At Vuono Group, you will get to work in a cross-competence team making our clients' businesses more intelligent with data. In practice, this means building data pipelines, integrating systems together, and utilising ML and AI for insights and operational use cases.

What We’re Looking For


Experience in planning and building production level data solutions that solve real business problems
An analytical mindset and problem-solving skills
Machine learning modeling and/or natural language processing experience
Experience in designing and implementing end-to-end data pipelines that transform raw operational data into business-ready information products
Experience in running and monitoring production workloads
Programming experience in Python and SQL
Willingness and readiness to learn and operate with new technology platforms, tools, whether low code like Celonis or Fabric or pro code like new cloud infrastructure
MSc degree in Machine Learning, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or similar
Professional-level Finnish and English language proficiency


The Following Is Considered a Plus


Interest in continuously learning and applying new technologies and platforms; generative AI, RAG, AI Agents, among others
Experience with various tech stacks, e.g. AWS Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, DBT, Apache Kafka, Terraform, or similar
Experience in utilising data from business technology platforms, such as ERP, CRM or similar (SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.)
Experience in transforming data for process and content intelligence purposes
Previous consulting experience


You don’t need to tick every box! What matters most is your drive to make a real impact!

What We Offer

We are building the best work environment for data, AI and business process professionals. To get there, we invest in the well-being and work-life balance as well as the professional development of our people. We operate on trust and transparency rather than titles, fostering a high-autonomy, growth-oriented environment where collaboration, impact, and everyone’s unique thoughts and ideas are valued.

In addition to the usual perks, such as work tools of your choice and extensive healthcare benefits, we also offer our employees the opportunity to invest in our rapidly growing company via an employee share program.

Work with Leading Nordic Companies

At Vuono Group, you’ll collaborate with Nordic clients on a range of challenging digital projects. Along the way, you’ll have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, architecture, and how solutions are built. Explore some of our client cases here.

We’re always on the lookout for new talent, which is why we recruit on a rolling basis. If this opportunity feels like the right fit for you, take the next step and submit your application! Once we receive your application, we’ll be in touch.

Our recruitment process typically includes at least two interviews, giving you the chance to meet some of our team members and giving us the opportunity to get to know you better: as a professional, a colleague, and a person. Reference checks are also a standard part of our process. We look forward to hearing from you!

Title: Data Scientist
HTML:
Easybrain is looking for a Data Scientist to join our Business Intelligence team. Our ML models run in production, powering LTV prediction and user acquisition optimization across a portfolio of games with billions of installs. Your focus will be on building new ML systems for ads monetization and game personalization from the ground up.

This is a hands-on, end-to-end role focused on improving business metrics. You will own your models from problem framing through research, production deployment, validation, and post-launch iteration.

Responsibilities:

  • Researching and developing ads monetization optimization (floor pricing, ad load balancing) - an open research problem: from studying the underlying dynamics and simple heuristics to ML models and potentially RL;
  • Predicting LTV and other key user metrics using large-scale behavioral data: improving forecast accuracy through new modeling approaches, data signals, and features;
  • Building in-game personalization systems: difficulty and content management;
  • Validating models through A/B tests in collaboration with the analytical team and bringing them to production


Tech stack: Python - you’re free to choose whatever ML tools fit the task best (PyTorch and LightGBM are in production today); ClickHouse, PostgreSQL, Airflow, MLflow, Docker.

Requirements:

  • Experience in predictive modelling and deploying ML models to production: framing an open problem, exploring the data, building baselines, and iterating towards an ML solution;
  • Strong knowledge of Python and hands-on experience with the modern ML stack;
  • Profound understanding of statistics and machine learning;
  • Experience in reinforcement learning, recommender systems, ad tech, or mobile games is a plus;
  • B2+ level of English;
  • Fluent Russian is required


Benefits:

Besides the engaging tasks, support from experienced colleagues, challenge, and drive, we offer:

  • Full support in relocating to countries where our offices are located;
  • High-end market salary with performance bonuses;
  • All needed equipment;
  • Regular company events and monthly Friday meetings;
  • Social benefits (private medical cover, sports reimbursement, etc.);
  • Paid vacations, sick days;
  • English, Greek, and Polish online language classes;
  • Reimbursement for education and professional development

Title: Data Scientist (Supply Chain focus)
Description:
If you're passionate about turning data into reliable, scalable solutions and excited about using your analytical skills and rigor to improve how products flow across a global supply chain – this role is for you. And if you enjoy tough puzzles, inventive ways to crack them, as well as opportunities to explain your solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences, – then this role is doubly for you.

In this position, you'll be a key contributor to global Data Science projects focused on inventory optimisation and risk management initiatives, transforming raw data into actionable insights and helping shape decisions that directly impact availability, cost, and service levels worldwide. You'll combine strong coding skills with analytical structure, and you’re comfortable balancing engineering tasks with clear, compelling storytelling for business audiences.

You'll understand how to build clean, maintainable data pipelines; you enjoy diving into operational datasets; and you know how to formulate the right analyses to answer our most pressing questions. You’ll collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Operations, and Data Science colleagues to deliver end-to-end solutions.

All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:

DELIVER PROJECTS PART OF EXISTING DATA SCIENCE SERVICE LINES

You'll support the team by efficiently managing, running, and delivering Data Science projects with a key focus on our Operations stakeholders. This end-to-end approach includes everything from project scoping, execution, quality assurance, and delivery via convincing presentations.

BUILD ROBUST DATA FOUNDATIONS

Not content focusing exclusively on existing service lines and initiatives, you'll actively think along and propose new ways of generating even more value for our stakeholders.

STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT

You'll build close relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Thanks to your collaborative attitude and ability to absorb constructive feedback, you will maximise the likelihood of making each and every Data Science initiative a success for the company.

Organisational Responsibilities

You'll work inside the Data Science Team and you'll support them with impact tracking, project and pipeline planning, preparing materials for the planning cycles, internal trainings, onboarding new colleagues, internal and external outreach and more.

Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role:


5+ years of experience in Data Science. Previous experience working on Data Science topics in Operations / Supply Chain is a plus.
Programming: proficient in at least one of R, Python, SQL with the ability and willingness to learn the other two.
Data Literacy: ability to prepare datasets ensuring top quality such that essence of said data and the implications for the problem at hand can be grasped quickly.
Technical Literacy: applied understanding of modern computing allows the candidate to do things which go beyond the strict definition of Data Science (git, API calls, web crawling, …).
Statistical Reasoning: applied understanding of Stats and Probability and know how to use these tools to reduce uncertainty in a business context (regression, visualisation).
Project Management: able to navigate evolving requirements, prioritise effectively, and scope work in a way that balances impact, effort, and stakeholder needs.
Presentation Skills: present coherent data stories at the appropriate level of abstraction given the audience.
Stakeholder Management: skilled at building mutually beneficial connections with functional stakeholders.
Pragmatic Critical Thinking: intuitively consider relevant costs/benefits in all decisions and act accordingly.
Outcome Driven: highly motivated to add value and to demonstrate that impact to the organisation.
Scientific Reasoning/ Scoping: ability to define and formulate new questions, in addition to answering given ones.
Grit: proven capability to see things through to the end even if initial feedback is discouraging.


Due to legal reasons, we are obliged to disclose the minimum salary according to the collective agreement for this position, which is EUR 2,911 gross per month. However, our attractive compensation package is based on market-oriented salaries and is therefore significantly above the stated minimum salary.

As an employer, we value diversity and support people in developing their potential and strengths, realizing their ideas and seizing opportunities. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, skin colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation or origin.

Title: Junior Data Scientist
Description:
Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are seeking a Junior Data Scientist to support our Product Science team in advancing our physiological feature pipeline. This role is ideal for a passionate, early-career data scientist who is eager to apply their technical skills to real-world health and wearable data, learn from industry experts, and contribute to meaningful health-tech solutions.

What You Will Do


Support the development of new human physiology-based features and sensor technology.
Assist in transforming multi-sensor data into actionable health metrics.
Contribute to the creation and maintenance of data analytics tools.
Participate in team initiatives, contributing to project execution and data processing tasks.
Support data collections, help draft technical reports, and assist in preparing findings for internal team reviews.
Collaborate with cross-functional team members to support broader project goals.


We would love to have you on our team if you have:


1–2+ years of experience in Data Science (or a strong portfolio of academic/personal projects), ideally involving real-world or sensor data.
Proficiency in Python; familiarity with deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and multimodal data fusion is a plus.
Foundational knowledge of forecasting, statistical analysis, and simulation techniques.
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a STEM-related field (e.g., engineering, computer science, mathematics, statistics).
Experience working with SQL, Git, and cloud environments (e.g., AWS).
A collaborative mindset, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and a willingness to learn in a fast-paced environment.
A proactive attitude and curiosity about the intersection of technology and human health.


What We Offer


Competitive Salary
Lunch benefit
Wellness benefit
Flexible working hours
Collaborative, smart teammates
An Oura ring of your own


Oura is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Individuals seeking employment at Oura are considered without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. We will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics.

We will work to ensure individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

We’ve been alerted to scammers posing as ŌURA recruiters, especially for remote roles. Please note:


Our jobs are listed only on the ŌURA Careers page and trusted job boards.
We will never ask for personal information like ID or payment for equipment upfront.
Official offers are sent through Docusign after a verbal offer, not via text or email.


Stay cautious and protect your personal details.

Title: Medior Data Scientist / ML Engineer
Description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Sopra Steria biedt op maat gemaakte end-to-end corporate technology- en softwareoplossingen die organisaties helpen gedurfde keuzes te maken en meetbare resultaten te boeken. Met meer dan 51.000 collega’s in bijna 30 landen behoren we tot de top van de Europese leveranciers van digitale oplossingen. Succesvolle organisaties in Europa vertrouwen op onze technologie vanwege onze voortdurende focus op innovatie, samenwerking en zakelijke ontwikkeling. The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Je kan waardevolle inzichten halen uit grote datasets. Als Data Scientist ontfutsel je deze door je vloeiend kennis van programmeertalen als Python en R en visualisatietools als Tableau en PowerBI. Je kan die inzichten communiceren naar stakeholders zodat ze de nodige stappen kunnen zetten. Onze data scientists zijn vaardig in Hadoop & Spark en cloudplatformen als AWS en Azure. Deze tools – samen met je data expertise – zorgen ervoor dat het bouwen van voorspellende modellen, het uitvoeren van hypothesis tests en het uitvoeren van verkennende data-analyse je heel natuurlijk af gaan.

Als Data Engineer zal je:


ruwe data omzetten in bruikbare inzichten en
schaalbare oplossingen
je richten op het ontwerp en de optimalisatie
van data-infrastructuur
processen automatiseren
zorgen voor een naadloze levering van data
microservices ontwikkelen om data lakes
toegankelijker en nuttiger te maken


Je zoekt steeds naar innovatieve manieren om de schaalbaarheid en bruikbaarheid van data te verbeteren. Van de eerste conceptontwikkeling tot de uiteindelijke implementatie—jij ontwikkelt en implementeert data oplossingen die sterke resultaten opleveren en de strategische doelen van onze klanten ondersteunen.

Functie-eisen

We zijn op zoek naar gepassioneerde collega’s die graag de grenzen willen verleggen op het gebied van digitale transformatie en technologie consulting. Bij Sopra Steria krijg je de kans om te werken aan impactvolle projecten en je vaardigheden te ontwikkelen in een constructieve teamomgeving. Jij wilt tot de besten behoren. Dat is waarom jij altijd naar manieren zoekt om jouw kennis uit te breiden en op de hoogte te blijven van de laatste trends en ontwikkelingen. Hou je van een uitdaging en vind je jezelf in (de meeste van) deze criteria? Dan kijken we nu al uit naar jouw sollicitatie.

Type werk: Hybrid

Locatie: Groningen, NL

Contracturen: 36-40

Type contract: Vast

Opleiding: HBO, WO, PhD

Ervaring: 3-4 jaar

Talen: Nederlands

Je hebt kennis van of ervaring in:

Need: Python, SQL, cloud platform (Azure, AWS, GCP), git, docker

Nice to have: BI, R, Databricks, wiskundige optimalisatie, Specialisatie(e.g. Tabular ML, Computer vision, NLP, Deep Learning), MLOps/devOps, Verantwoorde AI kennis, big data/distributed computing, ETL/ELT, Presentatie vaardigheden

Je zal deel uitmaken van een grote naam in de tech wereld die bekend is om consulting, digitale diensten en softwareontwikkeling. Je begeeft je tussen high-level professionals die durven in te zetten om hoge resultaten te behalen.

Aanvullende informatie

Je zal deel uitmaken van een grote naam in de tech wereld die bekend is om consulting, digitale diensten en softwareontwikkeling. Je begeeft je tussen high-level professionals die durven in te zetten om hoge resultaten te behalen.

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:


Een vast contract.
Een vast contract;
Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol;
Vakantiegeld van 8%;
Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten;

Title: Data Scientist
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious goal: to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.

40% of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet, with 10% of greenhouse gas emissions coming from food waste. 

We’re more than an app: we are a certified B Corporation with a mission to empower everyone to take action against food waste, so alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions - such as our Retail Technologies offering, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

We’re growing fast: Our community of 133 million registered users and 261,000 active partners across 21 countries, have together already prevented 517+ million meals from going to waste - avoiding over 1.397.000 tonnes of CO2e!

Your mission

We are looking for a Data Scientist to join our Product Analytics and Center of Excellence team at Too Good To Go.

In this role, you will help build and scale data science capabilities across product and business domains, enabling smarter, more automated, and more impactful decision-making.

As a marketplace, many of our most critical challenges revolve around supply-demand dynamics, user behavior, and marketplace efficiency. You will work on problems such as personalisation, optimisation, and forecasting, helping us move from reactive analysis to proactive, model-driven systems.

You will work as part of the Center of Excellence, partnering closely with Product, Analytics, and business teams through high-impact, project-based collaborations.

Your role

Partner with Product and business leaders to identify high-impact opportunities where data science can drive step-change improvements
Develop and deploy machine learning models and statistical methods to solve problems such as: Personalisation and recommendation systems, Marketplace optimisation (e.g. ranking, matching, supply-demand balance) and Demand and supply forecasting.
Translate ambiguous business problems into scalable models, algorithms, and data products
Design and contribute to experimentation and measurement frameworks to evaluate impact
Collaborate closely with Product Analysts, ML Engineers, and stakeholders within the Product Analytics and Center of Excellence, working in an embedded, project-based model
Take end-to-end ownership, from problem framing to model development and impact evaluation
Contribute to building data science best practices, tools, and standards across the company 

Requirements

Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Econometrics, or a related field
Strong experience applying machine learning and statistical modeling to product or business problems
Experience in at least one of the following areas: Personalisation / recommendation systems, Marketplace or optimisation problems, Forecasting (time series or causal)
Strong programming skills in Python and solid proficiency in SQL
Experience with experimentation (A/B testing) and impact measurement
Ability to operate in ambiguous problem spaces and translate them into structured solutions
Strong communication skills — able to influence product and business stakeholders
High ownership and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Our values

We win together: Food waste is a big beast to fight. We believe in a #oneteam.
We raise the bar: We always push for more. We work smart, smash barriers and elevate one another.
We keep it simple: Our ambitions are bold but our solutions are simple.
We build a legacy: We’re proud of the change we’re driving. 
We care: We always look out for each other. Caring is also about the way we do business. We do the right thing.

What We Have To Offer

An opportunity to work in a global social-impact company and certified B Corporation! where you can see a real and tangible impact in your role.
To be an integral part of our Data & Analytics team. We are eager for you to make an impact and contribute to the role of analytics across key decisions and our solution processes. Your insights are valuable, and we are here to listen.
Work-life balance is important to us! Focus on the job to be done, not the hours spent, there is no need for overtime.
We trust in our employees and encourage an autonomous environment that provides several opportunities for employees to contribute, develop and take ownership of their work in a way that works for them.
To be part of an international company, with over 1,300+ colleagues across 19 countries that are on the same important mission.
An informal environment, working alongside 170+ passionate people within Tech & Product
We celebrate our differences and our successes and have a strong values-driven team culture.
We work in a hybrid set-up and value in office work weekly.
We may be able to support you with a working visa in Copenhagen, please be prepared to discuss this topic further as your first stage interview.

How to apply

We take recruitment very seriously, so please carefully read everything we have written above. Please also check our website and international media in order to get a good overview of Too Good To Go.
Submit your CV in English.
Please note that we only accept applications coming through our platform. No CV will be accepted by email or LinkedIn direct messaging.

Job Ref:

A Movement for Everyone
We want to inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together. With that mission, it’s only natural that we want to build a diverse and inclusive team of highly capable individuals who are passionate about doing things in a better way. We strongly believe we all excel and are more creative when we’re allowed to be ourselves, and we’re committed to a culture where all of us belong.
We are an equal opportunity employer and all employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business need. If you need reasonable accommodation at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Title: Data Scientists & ML Engineers
Description:
Vårt team skapar datadrivna effektiva verksamheter - Visst vill du vara med?

Vill du arbeta med AI, Machine Learning och datadriven utveckling i projekt som gör skillnad på riktigt? På Agio får du kombinera teknik, analys och innovation i uppdrag som spänner över viktiga samhällsfunktioner.

Vi söker nu erfarna Data Scientists och ML Engineers till våra team i Stockholm och Luleå. Du väljer själv vilken ort du vill utgå ifrån.

Om rollerna

Som Data Scientist eller ML Engineer på Agio hjälper du våra kunder att ta nästa steg i sin digitala resa.

Våra kunder behöver stöd inom dessa två huvudinriktningar, och du behöver inte vara stark inom båda. En riktigt bra Data Scientist kan vara relevant för oss även utan erfarenhet som ML Engineer, och vice versa.

Data Scientist

Du använder data för att skapa konkret affärs- och verksamhetsvärde genom avancerad analys, statistik, Machine Learning och AI – för att exempelvis förutse, klassificera, optimera och skapa bättre beslutsstöd. Vi söker teknikorienterade Data Scientists som har en stark programmeringsvana. Du arbetar med:
Machine Learning-modeller för prediktion, klassificering och optimering
Prediktioner och prognoser
Att testa hypoteser och genomföra A/B-tester
Att träna, testa och utvärdera modeller
Att förklara analyser och resultat på ett begripligt sätt för verksamheten


ML Engineer

Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan Data Science och Data Engineering, med fokus på att få modeller och AI-lösningar att fungera i produktion – från experiment och PoC till skalbara produktionslösningar. Du arbetar med:
Att ta modeller framtagna av Data Scientists och göra dem produktionsklara
Att bygga lösningar för att träna, deploya och köra modeller automatiskt
Att säkerställa att modeller fungerar i produktion, med hänsyn till exempelvis latens och skalbarhet
Att övervaka modeller och följa drift, datadrift och prestanda över tid


Du blir en viktig del i att hjälpa organisationer att utnyttja digitaliseringens möjligheter, från effektivisering till helt nya arbetssätt.

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av
Minst 4 års arbete som Data Scientist, ML Engineer, dataanalytiker eller inom AI/ML-roller
Avancerad dataanalys och AI/ML-modeller – till exempel prediktion, klassificering, klustring eller produktionssättning av modeller, beroende på om din profil ligger mer åt Data Scientist eller ML Engineer
Python eller R
Versionshantering (Git)
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Beroende på vilken profil du känner dig mest hemma i väger vi även in:
Data Scientist: erfarenhet av bibliotek som scikit-learn, pandas/polars eller statsmodels, samt datavisualisering med Matplotlib, Seaborn eller BI-verktyg som Power BI
ML Engineer: erfarenhet av TensorFlow/PyTorch, containerteknik (Docker, Kubernetes) och verktyg för MLOps som MLflow


Det viktigaste för oss är inte en checklista av verktyg, utan att du faktiskt har arbetat med avancerad analys och modeller, eller med att sätta modeller och AI-lösningar i produktion.

Meriterande om du även har
Kunskap om informationssäkerhet, GDPR och etisk AI
Erfarenhet av Azure, AWS eller andra molntjänster, exempelvis Azure ML, SageMaker eller Databricks
API-integrationer och arbete med data från flera olika källor
Vana av RAG-lösningar, agenter och ramverk som LangChain, LangGraph eller LlamaIndex


Teamet du blir en del av

Du blir en del av vårt team inom Dataanalys & BI med konsulter i både Luleå och Stockholm. Här möter du kollegor som brinner för sitt område, som hjälper varandra att utvecklas och som tillsammans bygger lösningar från ax till limpa.

Området är prioriterat hos oss, och du kommer att spela en viktig roll i teamets fortsatta utveckling. Samtidigt får du en personlig och skräddarsydd utvecklingsresa där du tillsammans med teamet stärker Agios affär och skapar värde för våra kunder.

Varför Agio?

Agio erbjuder dig:
Trygghet genom kollektivavtal och stabila kundrelationer
En arbetsplats som värnar om balans i livet
En personlig kompetensresa där du får utvecklas i din riktning
En platt organisation där du får stort inflytande
Ett företag som satsar långsiktigt både på dig och våra kunder


Vill du växa med oss? Skicka in en ansökan genom att svara på några korta frågor nedan.

Title: Data Scientist - Strategic Analytics Team
Description:
Our Story

Unum Technology Centre in Carlow serves as a strategic software development and IT services centre supporting Unum, a leading provider of income protection in the US. Our team of IT professionals build solutions and critical business applications to digitally transform the way we do business.

This position for an experienced data scientist who is excited to transform data into actionable insights and impactful solutions which drive business results. The role requires significant technical expertise in the fields of computer programming, applied statistics and data manipulation; and relies on increasing business knowledge. While some review by a manager is expected, this individual will take initiative in identifying and executing data science approaches to support business priorities.

The Role


Design and execute analytical solutions using optimization, simulation, data mining and other statistical methods with a focus on delivering actionable business value.
Integrate large volume of data from different sources (including Snowflake, DB2, SQL Server, Web API and Teradata) to create data assets for ad-hoc analyses and larger studies.
Apply validation, aggregation, and reconciliation techniques to create rich modeling-ready data framework.
Construct and tune predictive models to explain and understand observed events, forecast expected behavior, or identify risk through scoring or clustering.
Efficiently interpret results and communicate findings and potential value to influence manager and leadership decision making.
Support integration of solutions within existing business processes using automation techniques.
Understand theory and application of current and emerging statistical methods and tools.
Provides support, training and/or mentorship to lower level Data Science peers.
Perform other related duties as assigned


What You Offer


Bachelor’s degree in quantitative field is required, Master’s is preferred
4 plus years of professional experience or equivalent relevant work experience preferred
Core Data Science Capabilities: Deep expertise in at least two of the following skillsets preferred; and competency in the other:
Programming – Experience in programming languages, such as Python and R, to develop programs for manipulating large and complex datasets data analysis and implementing algorithms.
Data Visualization: Expertise on at least one visualization tool with working knowledge of others and expertise in static data visualization. Understanding of dynamic data visualization.
Statistics & Statistical modeling: Expertise using statistical inference and regression. Solid understanding of machine learning algorithms. Solid understanding of feature selection and extraction. Conducts end-to-end machine learning tasks from problem synthesis to model deployment.
Data Extraction, Transformation, and Loading: Preferred skills include: Expertise in writing complex SQL queries that join multiple tables/databases. Independently explore databases/tables to identify best data sources to solve business problems. Demonstrates ability to troubleshoot complex SQL queries with little guidance.
Core business capabilities: Demonstrated communication skills, experience in financial services, leadership experience working with senior management and executive leadership, and attention to detail while effectively and independently prioritizing work and managing multiple projects simultaneously.
Leadership Capabilities: Demonstrated ability to coach or mentor team members, ability to commit quickly and positively to change. Viewed as a promoter of change management and leads proof of concept work and prototyping when necessary
Preferred characteristics: Entrepreneurial self-starter, a thorough, results-oriented problem-solver, and a lifelong learner with voracious curiosity who effectively works as part of a diverse team.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join one of our Telia Play teams, Content Voyage.

I’m Sara Hedenström, Head of Tech Content Voyage, and I’m searching for someone ready to grow with us. We’re a supportive, forward-thinking team focused on our mission to make entertainment deeply personal and intuitive. We are looking for a skilled Data Scientist to be the strategic brain behind our personalization features. In this role, you will act as the vital bridge between billions of behavioral signals and the intelligent features our viewers love. If you are passionate about training advanced machine learning models and want to see your algorithms directly shape what millions of people watch and discover, this is the role for you.

What you’ll do:

Build and scale deep learning models (ML Engineering & Data Science).


Build deep learning models: You will develop, optimize, and productionize our deep learning models using TensorFlow and Keras on GCP.
Orchestrate MLOps: Own end-to-end ML lifecycles using Vertex AI Pipelines and DVC, automating deployments with GitHub Actions and managing infrastructure via Terraform.
Drive experimentation: Design and execute rigorous A/B tests to measure the real-world impact of your models on user engagement and recommendation quality.
Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with Data Engineers, Product Managers, Backend, and Client teams to design ML features and ensure they are successfully delivered to users.
Model validation & analytics: Dive deep into the data using Python (Pandas, Polars) and SQL to understand model behavior, identify biases, and continuously improve prediction accuracy.
Shape our AI future: Bring a deep curiosity for modern ML techniques to help scale our infrastructure and build the next generation of adaptive, intelligent discovery features.


What will help you thrive in this role:

You are a strong communicator with the ability to explore and learn as we go. We believe in high standards with a playful mindset.


You are an experienced Data Scientist with proven hands-on experience building, training, and deploying production ML models on GCP (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage).
You have strong deep learning fundamentals and practical experience with TensorFlow/Keras, especially for recommendation systems, ranking, or retrieval tasks.
You are proficient in Python and SQL, comfortable with data processing libraries (Pandas, Polars), and understand how to optimize queries and data pipelines for performance.
You have strong ownership and care deeply about code quality, writing tests, documenting your work, and building systems that are reliable, maintainable, and easy for others to understand and extend.
You have a genuine passion for AI/ML and personalization. You are energized by seeing your algorithms directly change user behavior. You want your models to help millions of people spend less time browsing and more time enjoying the content they love.


Join us to shape smarter living for people, businesses, and the planet

At Telia, we’re a team of 15,000 colleagues across the Nordics and Baltics, passionate about technology and connectivity. As a Top Employer and Sustainability Leader, we drive change with large-scale, impactful projects while building a sustainable, inclusive world.

Here, you can grow your skills, lead meaningful projects, and thrive in a supportive, diverse environment. Whether you’re taking your first step or your next, Telia is a place to grow, belong, and make a real impact.

What We Offer

At Telia, we care about your well-being, growth, and sense of belonging:


Additional health insurance and pension plans
Workation: work from anywhere in the EU for up to 30 days per year
Extra vacation days based on tenure (up to 5 additional days)
Discounts on Telia services, including free home internet
Partner offers and discounts (SPA, cafes, events)
Telia Kids Club: summer camps for employees’ children
Company-supported sports activities (yoga, basketball, running)
Internal training, leadership programs and job shadowing to explore new roles


and more.

Monthly salary range for this position: 4,300-6,500 EUR gross + annual performance/sales bonuses. The final offer may vary depending on your skills and experience.

Ready to make better happen?

We look forward to receiving your application by September 21. Please note that we might close the position earlier if we find the right candidate, so don’t wait too long to apply!

If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our Talent Acquisition Partner. Background and reference checks will be part of the process.

Equal opportunities

At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where your uniqueness is our strength.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

The Role

The team Data Science and Research (DSR) at Etraveli Group consists of Data Scientists, ML Engineers, MLOps, and Data Engineers. The team operates across a wide spectrum of business functions ranging from content optimisation and revenue estimation, to ticket pricing, ancillary products and fraud detection. To implement new state-of-the-art products and consolidate our existing solutions the team is growing, and as our new Data Scientist you will have the opportunity to work with large-scale data sets and high-performance applications capable of processing billions of records every day. This is a challenging environment, where you will get to work with cutting edge ML technology used in production to support core business decisions and deliver the highest value to our customers.

Responsibilities


Develop and implement machine learning models and algorithms to solve complex business problems, optimize processes, and improve existing production solutions.
Mine, analyze, and visualize large-scale datasets to identify trends and patterns, and translate these insights into concrete business actions.
Work within high-performance applications capable of processing and handling billions of records every day.
Explore a diverse and evolving range of business functions, developing a deep understanding of new domains to identify where machine learning can drive growth.
Combine data from disparate sources, cleaning, preprocessing, and transforming it to ensure high accuracy and data integrity.
Collaborate closely with stakeholders to define project objectives, data requirements, and clear definition-of-done criteria.
Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure your models are successfully deployed into production.


You Can Also Have The Opportunity To


Together with Machine Learning, Data, and MLOps Engineers implement the models into our services according to our development standards.
Interpret and communicate findings to both technical colleagues and non-technical stakeholders through reports, presentations and visualizations.
Stay updated with the latest industry trends, tools, and techniques in data science and apply them to enhance our data-driven capabilities.


Requirements


University degree in a STEM discipline
2-3 years of experience as a Data Scientist or similar role in a corporate or research environment
Strong math skills (e.g. statistics, algebra)
Proficiency in Python
Experience with statistical analysis, data mining, and data visualization libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib)
Skilled in developing and deploying machine learning models utilizing core frameworks, including Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch
Familiarity with SQL and database querying for data extraction and manipulation.
Understanding of time series forecasting techniques is a plus
Excellent command of spoken and written English
Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) and ability to navigate large codebases
Exposure to ML orchestration and model management (e.g., Airflow, MLflow)
Demonstrated experience leveraging AI-powered productivity tools (e.g., coding assistants, automation workflows) to accelerate personal tasks and enhance individual efficiency


Benefits

We are looking for people who would make the world smaller for travelers but want a bigger world of opportunities for themselves. With us you can enjoy:


Hybrid working environment - having the opportunity to work both remotely and at the office enabling you flexibility!
Health Benefits - Through partners we offer a private health insurance plan. We also offer the possibility to use 2 extra medical leave days in case of need.
Monthly ticket restaurant card - to spend in one of the thousands of affiliated restaurants, cafes, stores or supermarkets across Greece.
Office in the City – We sit on bright, large floors (over 4000㎡!) in central Athens. Just a short walk from the Ambelokipi Metro station.
Growth – We believe in personal development and continuous education, thus we offer the opportunity of role-related training on tools and best practices.
We also like to schedule company/department/team activities and events outside the office space!
We have a relaxed & fun work environment where you can enjoy free breakfast coffee/tea, playing ping pong or video games.


Why Join Us?

You’ll work on a core product that shapes the travel experience of millions of users worldwide, in a dynamic and evolving industry. You'll work with a passionate team dedicated to excellence, be a key player in shaping our flight content strategy, influence partners, and grow in a supportive environment that values innovation. If you're ready to elevate your career and make a real difference in the world of travel, apply now and become a vital part of our mission to be the best in the business!

Diversity disclaimer

At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.

Title: Full Stack Data Scientist
Description:
Millaisesta työstä sinä innostuisit juuri nyt?




Olisiko työn haastettava ja kehitettävä taitojasi? Tulisiko sen tuottaa tunne, että olet tekemässä jotain merkittävää? Haluaisitko työskennellä työyhteisössä, jossa välittäminen näkyy jokapäiväisissä teoissa ja kohtaamisissa?




Mitä jos sanoisimme, että meillä työskennellessäsi nämä kaikki seikat yhdistyvät yhdeksi – sinun erinomaiseksi työntekijäkokemukseksesi.




🚀 Lyhyt kuvaus työstäsi Full Stack Data Scientistina

Kanssamme luot asiakkaillemme liiketoiminnallista arvoa ja konkreettista kilpailuetua auttamalla heitä tekemään parempia päätöksiä datan avulla.




Konsultoit, kehität ja viet eteenpäin innovaatioita, jotka auttavat yrityksiä ja yhteisöjä toimimaan fiksusti ja ketterästi. Teet monimutkaisesta yksinkertaista uusimmilla teknologioilla, tehokkaimmilla laskentatavoilla ja parhailla käytännöillä.




Teknologisesta näkökulmasta erilaiset tietovarastot, laskentaympäristöt ja datankäsittelytyökalut ovat osa arkeasi siinä missä pilvipalvelut (AWS, ja Azure ja GCP) sekä ohjelmointikielet ovat erottamaton osa työtäsi.




Vielä lisää konkretiaa

Olemme ylpeitä, kuinka jatkuva oppiminen on luonnollinen osa nitorilaisten päivittäistä asiakasprojektissa työskentelyä. Lue Data Scientistimme, Tuukka Stewenin oppimismatkasta.

Täältä pääset tutustumaan Finnairille toteuttamaamme operatiivisen toiminnan työkaluun.

Data Scientistimme ja projektissa mukana ollut tuleva työkaverisi Jukka kertoo kokemuksiansa projektista ja meillä työskentelystä täällä.

Miltä dataosaajamme työpäivä näyttää – käy vilkaisemassa Eeron tarina.




🤝 Dataliiketoimintamme on yksi kasvualueistamme




Meillä on kokemusta ja osaamista merkittävien toimeksiantojen toteuttamiseen. Asiakastyytyväisyytemme on huippuluokkaa ja kehitämme jatkuvasti toimintaamme.




Katseemme on myös vahvasti tulevassa. Kun tulet työkaveriksemme, uskomme, että se vie meitä taas askeleen eteenpäin – samalla kun katsomme sinulle uraasi ja kehittymistäsi tukevat toimeksiannot, joissa työskentelet yhdessä toisten nitorilaisten kanssa. Meillä saat toteuttaa näköistäsi työelämää yhteiseen tulevaisuuteemme vaikuttaen.




Tuleva data-asiantuntijoiden tiimisi on tiivis startup-henkinen ja uuden oppimista arvostava, jolta löytyy poikkeuksellisen korkeatasoista dataosaamista. Ja jos palaset loksahtavat kohdalleen, tätä joukkoa sinä täydennät juuri sellaisena kuin olet.




✅ Mitä sinä voisit tuoda mukanasi?




Tässä tehtävässä loistat, kun sinulla on ohjelmointikokemusta, kyky kehittää koodia modernein menetelmin sekä matemaattisen ajattelun mentaliteetti ja taito. Olet kiinnostunut tekoälystä ja koneoppimisesta. Koska ala menee eteenpäin vauhdilla, on tärkeää, että olet innostunut uuden omaksumisesta ja näet haasteet mahdollisuuksina.




Mitä enemmän sinulla on osaamista, se luonnollisesti tarjoaa enemmän mahdollisuuksia heti ensimetreistäsi lähtien. Emme kuitenkaan halua liian tarkkaan määrittää tässä kohtaa, millainen sinun tulisi olla. Palaset kun voivat loksahtaa kohdalleen niin monella tapaa.




🏆Mitä jos valitsisitkin meidät?

Me uskomme, että rekrytoinnissa ei ole kyse siitä, että yritys valitsee uuden työntekijän. Sinä lopulta teet valinnan. Ja me voimme sinua siinä auttaa.




Sinun kannattaa olla meihin yhteydessä, jos

haluat työskennellä mielekkäiden toimeksiantojen parissa relevantteja, uusia asioita oppien.
rinnallasi työskentelevät osaavat kollegat, erinomaiset kouluttautumismahdollisuudet sekä optimaaliset työolosuhteet ja -välineet ovat sinulle tärkeitä asioita.
koet, että yhteisöllisyys ja toisille hyvän tahtominen ovat työelämässä merkityksellisiä arvoja.
sinusta on ihan ok tehdä normityöaikaa ja huolehtia, että vapaat ja työt pysyvät balanssissa.
työskentelet mielelläsi pitkäaikaisissa asiakkuuksissa projektista toiseen poukkoilun sijaan.




Työskentelyäsi ja arkeasi tukevat meillä myös muuten hyvin monimuotoiset edut ja mahdollisuudet:




Voit esimerkiksi käyttää 10 % työajastasi ammatilliseen kehittymiseen.
Palkitsemme suorittamasi sertifikaatit bonuksin (500–2000 €/sertifikaatti).
Saat käyttöösi 7100 € työvälineiden hankkimiseen.
Sinulla on mahdollisuus palkalliseen lomaan heti meillä aloitettuasi.
Lisäksi meillä on kattavat henkilöstöedut ja innostavaa yhteistä ajanviettoa.




⭐ Haluaisitko jutella kanssamme tarkemmin, mitä me voisimme sinulle tarjota?

Liity nyt data-ammattilaistemme, koodareidemme, suunnittelijoidemme ja valmentajiemme joukkoon työskentelemään luovassa sekä byrokratiavapaassa työkulttuurissa.




Olisimme todella innostuneita kuulemaan sinusta lisää. Kerro, millaista askelta olet urallasi ottamassa, ja katsotaan, miten me voisimme sinua auttaa.




❓Onko mielessäsi kysymyksiä? Pohdituttaako jokin seikka?

Lähetä meille viesti niin People Partnerimme Ella Raskila (ella.raskila@nitor.com) vastaa kaikkiin kysymyksiisi ja auttaa sinua. Varmistetaan, että saat kaiken tarvitsemasi tiedon sinulle tärkeän päätöksen tekemiseksi.




👥 Me kuuntelemme sinua

Me haluamme tarjota työntekijöillemme parhaan mahdollisen työpaikan ja tukea sinun osaamisesi kehittymistä. Nitorilla juuri sinä, ainutlaatuiset taitosi ja henkilökohtaiset kiinnostuksen kohteesi määrittävät urasi suunnan.

Kiehtovat projektit, luontainen uteliaisuutemme ja kollegojesi tuki motivoivat sinua jatkuvassa oppimisessa. Osallistut mielenkiintoisiin koulutuksiin, tapahtumiin ja konferensseihin. Lisäksi voit käyttää osan työajastasi uuden oppimiseen, yhteisömme kehittämiseen sekä sinua inspiroiviin pro bono –projekteihin.

Meillä urapolkusi ei ole ennalta määrätty – päinvastoin, kannustamme sinua tutkimaan kiinnostuksen kohteitasi ilman turhaa hierarkiaa ja byrokratiaa. Nitorilla äänesi kuuluu.




🎯 Lyhyesti Nitorista – toivottavasti sinunkin tulevasta työpaikastasi

Jokainen nitorilainen on pragmaattinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen tiimipelaaja, joka ei tyydy oletuksiin. Meille ominaista ovat todella korkea ammattitaito ja ylpeys niin omasta kuin kollegoidemmekin työstä.

Yli 250 asiantuntijaamme toimivat Helsingissä, Tampereella ja Tukholmassa, yhdistäen monipuoliset osaamisensa merkityksellisten vaikutusten saavuttamiseksi. Olemme ylpeitä työntekijälähtöisestä kulttuuristamme ja aidosta sitoutumisestamme ihmistemme kasvuun – tunnustuksena tästä meidät on palkittu Great Place to Work -sertifikaatilla sekä valittu Suomen vetovoimaisimmaksi työnantajabrändiksi.




Visiomme on selkeä: olla alan halutuin työpaikka, jossa menestys syntyy työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden hyvinvoinnista ja tyytyväisyydestä. Jatkamme kasvuamme IT-alan asiakastyytyväisyyden suunnannäyttäjänä tuottaen erinomaista lisäarvoa asiakkaillemme (lue, miten ainutlaatuinen asiakaskokemus ruokkii kasvuamme).

Jokainen nitorilainen on pragmaattinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen tiimipelaaja, joka ei tyydy oletuksiin. Meille ominaista ovat todella korkea ammattitaito ja ylpeys niin omasta kuin kollegoidemmekin työstä.

Yli 250 asiantuntijaamme toimivat Helsingissä, Tampereella ja Tukholmassa, yhdistäen monipuoliset osaamisensa merkityksellisten vaikutusten saavuttamiseksi. Olemme ylpeitä työntekijälähtöisestä kulttuuristamme ja aidosta sitoutumisestamme ihmistemme kasvuun – tunnustuksena tästä meidät on palkittu Great Place to Work -sertifikaatilla sekä valittu Suomen vetovoimaisimmaksi työnantajabrändiksi.


Visiomme on selkeä: olla alan halutuin työpaikka, jossa menestys syntyy työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden hyvinvoinnista ja tyytyväisyydestä. Jatkamme kasvuamme IT-alan asiakastyytyväisyyden suunnannäyttäjänä tuottaen erinomaista lisäarvoa asiakkaillemme (lue, miten ainutlaatuinen asiakaskokemus ruokkii kasvuamme).

Title: Python Developer / Data Scientist
Description:
Python Developer / Data Scientist

Overview

A Python developer with a data science background to become the long-term owner of the NDT project. The developer will co-build across the entire codebase with the current team to understand it and then take over ownership once the current team leaves. From that point, the developer will keep the project running and continuously adapt it to changing business requirements.

Expected Tools & Knowledge

Must have

Python: solid and production-minded

Data science

Experiment tracking with MLflow

Collaborative programming and Git

Self-reliance, with the ability to unblock minor technical issues independently

Nice to have

Classical machine learning

Computer vision

Kubernetes

REST / FastAPI

Responsibilities

Co-build across the entire codebase with the current team and prepare to take full ownership once they leave.

Own the project long term, maintain it, and continuously adapt it to changing business requirements.

Continuously evaluate model performance.

Collect new data and re-trigger model training when needed.

Critically challenge the training data and determine whether a model is good enough to deploy.

Competencies

Python & Software Engineering

Solid, production-minded Python.

Comfortable taking over and maintaining an existing codebase.

Uses Git and works effectively in a collaborative development setup.

Data Science & Model Judgment

Strong grounding in data science.

Questions whether the training data is sound and whether a model is genuinely ready to deploy, rather than trusting metrics at face value.

Evaluates model performance and knows when to collect data and retrain.

Business Stakeholder Interaction

Works directly with business stakeholders to understand and clarify changing requirements.

Translates business requests into concrete changes to the project.

Communicates results and model limitations clearly to non-technical audiences.

Title: Data Scientist - Data Analyst
Description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Being part of EY in Greece means being part of a continuously growing team, which has been announced as Top Employer for the fourth consecutive year, certified as a Great Place to Work for the third year in a row, and awarded as Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting for the second consecutive time, for our almost 3,000 professionals!

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences through coaching and training programs as well as the use of advanced technology and AI. We’ll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams

Join us as we commemorate 100 years of EY in Greece this year. Experience great flexibility under our hybrid operating model across our offices in Athens, Patras, Thessaloniki and Crete and contribute to building a better working world.

The opportunity

We are currently seeking highly motivated people for our Consulting practice, which is a leading provider of services to financial industry and large corporate clients of all industries. Being part of our AI & Data team, you will work with multi-disciplinary teams across the entire EMEIA region to support global clients.

Your Key Responsibilities

You will identify appropriate modeling techniques to answer the most critical business questions and use your analysis to infer well substantiated business insights in support of your clients’ decision making.

You will also resort to various data management and visualization techniques to provide insight into the data. Your portfolio of skills covers a wide range of advanced statistical and machine learning techniques for classification, prediction, recommendation, clustering, forecasting, as well as data management, data visualization, and optimization, applied in a commercial context. You will contribute to presentations of modeling results and project proposals.

To qualify for the role you must have


Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a Bachelor or a Master’s degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Econometrics, Engineering, Operational Research, Computer Science, or other related field with strong quantitative focus.
2-7 years of working or related research experience (evidenced by PhD and/or relevant publications, awards, or completed project credentials) with preferably at least 2 years in a commercial/industrial context and particular focus on the following:
Data modeling and Management, integration and manipulation of large disparate datasets (i.e. structured, semi-structured or unstructured)
Predictive modeling and optimization
Strong skills in databases, statistical packages for data manipulation and in development of predictive and prescriptive models (i.e. R, Python, SAS, SPSS, SQL).
Experience in designing, building, testing and validating models using a large number of statistical and other quantitative techniques.


Ideally, you’ll also have


Software development experiences in Java and/or C/C++ as well as advanced databases.
Experience with Big Data/In Memory technologies, such as Hadoop (Hortonworks, Cloudera etc), SAP HANA, IBM BigInsights, Oracle Exalytics.
Experience with scalable big data based advanced analytics software, such as Apache Mahout or 0xdata H2O.
Experience in Advanced Data Visualization tools, such as Tableau, Spotfire, Qlikview and others for integration between disparate data sources, design and implementation of KPIs and generation of automatic and scalable visualizations that will facilitate extraction of business insights.


Skills And Attributes For Success


Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills in English for both technical and business audiences.
Strong analytical, problem solving and critical thinking skills.
Ability to work under tight timelines for multiple project deliveries.
Ability/flexibility to travel and work abroad for international projects.


What We Look For

What’s most important is that you’re dedicated to working with your colleagues as part of a high-performing team. You’ll need to demonstrate enthusiasm, high motivation and passion to develop fast in a multinational working environment. You’ll need to thrive in picking up new skills and talents as you go, so natural curiosity, a lot of questions and the confidence to speak up when you see something that could be improved are essential. If you’ve got the right combination of technical knowledge and communication skills, this role is for you.

What We Offer You

Ability to Shape your Future with Confidence by:


Developing your professional growth:
You'll have unlimited access to educational platforms, EY Badges and EY Degrees, alongside support for certifications. You will experience personalized coaching and feedback, and gain exposure to international projects, through our expansive global network, empowering you to define and achieve your own success.
Dive into our innovative GenAI ecosystem, designed to enhance your EY journey and support your career growth. These advanced AI tools will empower you to focus on higher-value work and meaningful interactions, enriching your professional experience like never before.
Empowering your personal fulfilment: We focus on your financial, social, mental and physical wellbeing.
Our competitive rewards package, depending on your experience, includes cutting-edge technological equipment, ticket restaurant vouchers, a private health and life insurance scheme, income protection and an exclusive EY benefits club card that provides a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions.
Our flexible working arrangement (hybrid model) is defined based on your own preferences and team’s needs, and we enjoy various getaways such as short Fridays, Flex Day and Together Day.
Our commitment to a sustainable way of operating, encourages volunteerism, promotes sustainable practices and offers opportunities for you to create a positive societal impact.
Our pride lies in working at EY as one of the most recognized employers in Greece through our multiple awards received over the last 4 years (Top Employer, Great Place to Work and Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting).
Fueling an inclusive culture: We prioritize a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment, where you’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Since you’ve landed on this page, you already know Hedvig is a mover and shaker in insurtech, and think you might have what it takes to join us. We’ve been working hard since the very beginning to change an industry that is hard to love – to something at least likable. At Hedvig, we believe the only way to do so is to work with great people.




What about the role?

We are now looking for a Data Scientist to join our ambitious team at Hedvig, to solve complex business problems across the Hedvig using the latest advancements in AI and Machine Learning. The role involves high-impact work designing and developing ML models and agentic AI solutions for fair pricing, reserving, and lifetime value and more.




We believe, and know from experience, that we can accelerate faster by owning the entire pipeline from raw data to deployed model, reaping the benefits from developing with AI. Working closely with experienced backend developers, ML engineers, data analysts, and various business teams, you will have the opportunity to shape the data, tools, and innovative solutions that fuel our growth. This offers an inspiring freedom in what you will be able to create.




In the role you will:




Be a driving force in the development of our proprietary, next generation pricing platform powered by agentic AI development
Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and agentic AI systems to solve challenges across the business, including:
Engineering dynamic risk models to deliver highly personalized and competitive premium structures that balance fairness with sustainable profitability
Performing and developing the end-to-end reserving process, blending actuarial analysis with the continuous automation of our workflows
Driving sales growth by developing and deploying Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) models to optimize our marketing strategies
Drive machine learning and AI projects from project definition and raw data to deployed model and tracking of performance, with full end-to-end ownership
Evangelize the power of data and AI by promoting your work to the team, stakeholders and Hedvig as a whole
Be a driving force by always being on the lookout for new trends within AI, and Insurtech




What about you?

The Foundation: You hold a Master’s. in Computer Science, Engineering Physics, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
Proven Impact: Relevant professional experience delivering ML models end-to-end in production, preferably in Fintech or Insurtech. Direct exposure to insurance pricing, actuarial frameworks, or credit risk modeling is a significant advantage that will distinguish your profile.
The Generative Frontier: You are hands-on or experimenting with the modern AI stack, including LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases, and fine-tuning
Agentic Thinking: You have a thirst for building and deploying agentic AI systems capable of complex, multi-step decision-making and tool-use within a business context
From Foundations to Frontiers: You possess a deep algorithmic understanding of machine learning models - from classical GLMs and GBMs to Transformers. You use this knowledge to independently select, develop, interpret, and evaluate the most appropriate solutions for complex problems.
Full-Stack Mindset: You are highly proficient in Python and standard DS libraries, with strong working knowledge of SQL and experience preparing, transforming and working with large datasets for ML.
Production-Ready: Experience deploying and operating ML solutions in a cloud environment (GCP, AWS, or Azure), including model versioning, monitoring, CI/CD and best MLOps practices.
The AI Advocate: You thrive in collaborations, translating problems into rigorous quantifiable solutions, and love evangelizing ML models and agentic AI
Business impact: You independently validate models and interpret their performance to make decisions maximising the business impact of them.




Those are not hard requirements! If you have a different profile but you see that you have relevant skills and you think you can do a remarkable job, apply and share with us your motivation on why we should meet you.




What about us?

As part of the Hedvig team, you quickly notice that "general truths" are not accepted without being questioned. We're an enthusiastic group of people who love to challenge each other to find the best way forward. We don't care who says something; we care about what's being said. We put a lot of effort into building a trusting culture where freedom, collective thinking, and individual ownership have center stage. We're not perfect – far from it – but we talk about and learn from our mistakes and imperfections to improve continuously. And we have a lot of fun along the way! As individuals, as a team, and as a company.




Come join the Hedvig team, including all of our very loved office pups, in newly renovated offices in central Stockholm.

Title: Data Scientist (m/w/d) Forecasting & Demand Planning
Description:
Jeden Abend wirft der Handel Ware weg, die niemand bestellt hat. Und gleichzeitig steht jemand vor einem leeren Regal. Beides sind Planungsfehler und beide lassen sich rechnen.




Genau das machen wir bei Circly: KI-gestützte Absatzprognosen für Handel, FMCG und Industrie. Unsere Kund:innen planen damit Bestellmengen, Produktion und Personal. Wenn dein Modell besser wird, landet weniger im Müll. Das ist kein Marketing-Satz, das ist die Metrik.




Wir sind ein Team mit Büro im 1. Bezirk. Kein Data-Team in einer Konzernabteilung, das Tickets abarbeitet. Du sprichst mit den Kund:innen, deren Daten du modellierst, und mit dem Founder-Team sitzt du im selben Raum.


Aufgaben


Du entwickelst und verbesserst unsere Forecasting-Modelle für Absatz- und Bedarfsprognosen.




Du bereitest Kund:innendaten auf: Datenanbindung, Bereinigung, Feature Engineering




Du analysierst Prognosegüte, findest Ursachen für Abweichungen und leitest daraus Modellverbesserungen ab




Du bereitest Ergebnisse verständlich auf, in Berichten und im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kund:innen




Du bringst deine Ideen ins Produkt ein und arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung und Founder-Team zusammen


Qualifikation


Das solltest du mitbringen





mindestens 3 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung als Data Scientist oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle


sicherer Umgang mit Python und den gängigen Bibliotheken (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn)


mindestens ein Datenprojekt, das du von der Rohdatei bis zum fertigen Ergebnis umgesetzt hast


Erfahrung in Datenvorverarbeitung und Data Engineering


analytisches Denken und die Fähigkeit, Ergebnisse für Nicht-Techniker:innen verständlich zu machen





Von Vorteil





Erfahrung in FMCG, Handel, Supply Chain oder Produktion


Forecasting, Zeitreihenanalyse, Demand Planning


Docker, Git, Aufbau von Datenpipelines


Erfahrung mit moderner ML-Infrastruktur oder agentischen Ansätzen



Benefits


Gehalt: EUR 3.175 – 4.400 brutto/Monat (14x jährlich, All-in)




Überzahlung je nach Erfahrung und QualifikationBüro im 1. Bezirk, sehr gut erreichbar




flexible Arbeitszeiten und anteilig Homeoffice




direkter Einfluss auf Produkt und Roadmap, kein Ticket-Abarbeiten




flache Hierarchien, Entscheidungen ohne Gremienwege




Du musst kein Anschreiben schreiben. Ein paar Sätze, warum dich das interessiert, dein Lebenslauf und falls vorhanden, ein Link zu GitHub oder LinkedIn reichen uns völlig.




Wir melden uns asap zurück, auch wenn es eine Absage wird.

Title: Data scientist (m/f) - A1
HTML:
Informations générales

  • Statut: Employé de l'État

  • Groupe d'indemnité: A1

  • Nombre de postes vacants: 1

  • Nationalité: Être ressortissant UE

  • Catégorie de métiers: Technologie de l'information et de la communication

Qui recrute ?

L’Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD) recherche un Data Scientist pour son Département Données, Analyses, et IA. Le candidat contribuera à renforcer la détection des risques liés aux réglementations fiscales, en développant des solutions innovantes pour automatiser la conformité, optimiser les processus fiscaux et soutenir la prise de décision stratégique.

Missions

  • Analyser des données administratives complexes (non conçues pour l’analyse) pour en extraire des insights actionnables;

  • Participer au développement et maintenance de pipelines de données pour valoriser des données internes et externes;

  • Concevoir et maintenir des applications analytiques (ex : Dataiku, streamlit , QLIK) pour cibler les fraudes ou soutenir les décisions;

  • Collaborer avec les équipes métiers pour traduire leurs besoins en solutions data (ex : modèles de segmentation, outils de compliance);

  • Innover avec de nouvelles technologies (intelligence artificielle) tout en garantissant leur usage approprié.

Profil

Compétences techniques

  • Savoir développer des applications Data/IA en Python : code modulaire, testable, et déployable en production (bonnes pratiques DevOps);

  • Expérience en traitement de données avec python, SQL / VQL (virtualisation des données) pour nettoyer, lier et analyser des datasets structurés et non structurés;

  • Expérience en analyse de séries temporelles, en optimisation mathématique, et des modèles de simulation;

  • Savoir utiliser des techniques statistiques, Machine Learning, et IA générative pour découvrir des relations cachées;

  • Expérience démontrée en traduction de problèmes métiers (ex : fraude, compliance) en solutions data/IA;

  • Savoir définir des MVPs (Minimum Viable Product) prioriser les livrables et travailler avec une approche « build – measure - learn »;

  • Savoir expliquer des concepts techniques à des non-experts (ex : présenter un modèle de détection de fraude à des agents fiscaux);

  • Savoir choisir la bonne technologie pour communiquer et visualiser des résultats.

Compétences comportementales

  • Rigueur, autonomie, pédagogie et collaboration multidisciplinaire;

  • Adaptabilité aux évolutions réglementaires et technologiques;

  • Motivation et capacité d’apprentissage rapide pour maîtriser les spécificités fiscales internationales.

Atouts

  • Une exposition à un environnement fiscal ou réglementé (finance, assurance, administration publique) est un atout clé pour ce rôle;

  • Connaissance des enjeux de transparence fiscale internationale et des outils associés;

  • Maitrise courante de l’anglais.

Conditions d’admission

Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut de l'employé de l'État.

Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission pour devenir employé de l'État.

Diplômes

Vous êtes titulaire d’un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d’enseignement supérieur reconnu par l’État du siège de l’établissement et sanctionnant l’accomplissement avec succès d’un master en informatique, mathématiques, data science ou de son équivalent.

Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications.

Expérience

Vous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans dans le domaine.

Langues

Vous répondez aux exigences des connaissances de 3 langues administratives pour le groupe d'indemnité A1. Une dispense de deux des trois langues administratives peut être accordée sous certaines conditions.

Nationalité

Vous êtes ressortissant d’un État membre de l’Union européenne.

Documents à fournir

Lettre de motivation, copie du diplôme, CV



  • Pour ce poste, vous devez obligatoirement postuler en ligne via MyGuichet, les candidatures via courriel ou via courrier postal n’étant pas acceptées. Les documents sont à introduire via MyGuichet en format pdf (taille maximale 20 Mo).

Title: Data Scientist – Cloud Data Technologies
Description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

The Cloud Data Technologies (CDT) team at eBay is responsible for eBay’s data infrastructure, including the experimentation platform and the end-to-end data lifecycle, from onsite data through to analytics use cases.

We are seeking a Data Scientist to help improve the speed and quality of decision-making by applying advanced data science methods and turning complex data into actionable insights. Use advanced SQL to work with large-scale datasets and optimize big data queries.
Collaborate with multi-functional teams to define requirements and develop data solutions that support effective decision-making.
Contribute to machine learning use cases such as bot traffic detection and customer profile development.
Evaluate relevant developments in data science and identify new technologies or methodologies that could improve existing approaches.

5+ years of relevant experience with a master’s degree or Ph.D. in Computer Science or another quantitative field.
Experience building statistical or machine learning models and evaluating model performance.
Proficiency in Python or R and relevant machine learning libraries, such as scikit-learn or GBM.
Advanced SQL skills, including experience optimizing queries for large-scale data.

Strong problem-solving skills and experience deploying machine learning models in production environments.
Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings to non-technical audiences.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR Senior Data Scientist

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist who turns industrial data into operational decisions - not just models, and not just dashboards. You'll lead data science work in real production environments across heavy industry, chemicals, manufacturing, logistics and energy. The hard part here isn't fitting a model: it's figuring out what to predict, from what data, and whether it's worth doing at all. This is the role for someone who has seen projects stall because the team modelled whatever data happened to be available - and wants to solve that properly.

What You'll Do


Assess data sources, quality and gaps to determine what is realistically predictable - and demand the right enrichments and history before modelling
Predict machine failure and maintenance needs (RUL, lifecycle), and optimize production efficiency, energy use and operational flows
Combine predictive models with optimization to turn forecasts into prioritized actions - an approach we call Composite AI: the model predicts, optimization decides under real constraints, and the output is a decision, not just a score
Scope problems with clients using a structured method (CRISP-DM or equivalent) - business and data understanding before modelling
Assess feasibility: define use cases, KPIs and a high-level business case, and recommend the data, instrumentation or process changes needed
Build interpretable models that support diagnostics and operational decisions
Work hands-on with modern AI tooling and agentic workflows - we expect our data scientists to use the best tools, not just talk about them


Required Qualifications


5+ years in data science, ideally with industrial, manufacturing or process-industry use cases
Process-industry data sense: you read production data in its process context, not just as statistical signals
A structured, methodical approach you actually follow - you don't jump straight to the model
Strong Python and SQL, solid time-series analytics, and comfort taking models toward production
Experience with anomaly detection, clustering and deep learning for sensor data
A communicative, proactive working style - you engage stakeholders and translate operational reality into data requirements
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure)
Bonus: mathematical optimization (LP/MIP, e.g. CPLEX / CP Optimizer), combining predictive ML with optimization, R, and prior work with manufacturing or industrial clients
