Title: Data Science Engineer (f/m/d) - ID:2699811
Description:
WHAT WE BUILD




Most companies find out about supplier insolvencies, cyber attacks, factory fires or floods that affect their supply chain when it's already a crisis. Prewave exists to change that. We're an AI-native company giving BMW Group, Hilti and Lufthansa real-time visibility into supply chain risks before they become headlines.




We're looking for a Data Science Engineer who takes ownership of turning vast, complex data into actionable intelligence from day one. Someone who uses AI as a default part of how they work - and knows when to trust their own judgment.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN




Decode the data – Leverage natural language processing (NLP) to extract meaning from diverse datasets.
Think like a scientist – Formulate hypotheses, uncover patterns, and pinpoint optimization opportunities.
Build smarter AI – Develop, fine-tune, and deploy machine learning models using Torch and TensorFlow.
Bridge research & reality – Transform cutting-edge algorithms into production-ready solutions.
Keep models sharp – Monitor, enhance, and continuously improve model performance and accuracy.
Expand the data universe – Identify and integrate new data sources to enrich our intelligence.
Collaborate & innovate – Work with cross-functional teams to tackle business challenges with data-driven solutions.




WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR




You are the right fit if you have:

Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics or related fields
3+ years of experience in developing, deploying and scaling machine learning models to production
Experience with NLP or other machine learning technologies, machine learning techniques and tools like Torch or Tensorflow
Good experience in working with Python and Scala
Knowledge of SQL and relational databases
Strong problem-solving skills, comfortable with ambiguity and open-ended questions
End-to-end ownership, from prototyping a model to deploying and monitoring it in production




Nice to have:

Master’s degree in a related field
Understanding of cloud-based services, especially Google Cloud Platform or AWS
Knowledge of NoSQL database systems
Knowledge of agile software development techniques
Experience with agent engineering and AI tools like Cursor, Claude etc.




WHAT’S OUR WORKING STYLE




We're a robust AI-native team building an AI-native resilience product - and we hire for both. For us, AI-native has always meant humans and AI working together, not one replacing the other. We use tools like Claude and Cursor as a normal part of the job, to think faster, work smarter and spend less time on the repetitive stuff. We treat AI fluency as a skill like any other - something you build, experiment with and keep developing.




What that works alongside is real ownership. You'll have the space and the trust to figure things out your way - with a strong team around you and plenty of support when you need it. Things move fast here and the brief won't always be complete, but that's what makes the work interesting.

The people who do best at Prewave are curious by default, go after things rather than wait to be handed them, and don't lose their footing when the plan changes.




We score six values in every interview - creating positive impact, optimising for customer value, being an ambitious innovator, operating with urgency, doing things that make sense and collaborating with kindness - so you always know what we're looking for and can prepare accordingly.




THE PACKAGE




Minimum EUR 45,738 gross annually based on IT Collective Agreement. Flexible hours and hybrid working.




Your birthday off. MyClubs partnership. Mental health support. Regular health check-ups and initiatives. Company-wide training. Fun team events. Device of choice. Work from anywhere - up to 8 weeks a year.

Title: Data Scientist till HiQ Syd
Description:
Data Scientists – dags att göra avtryck i höst!

När löven börjar skifta färg, luften blir krispigare och hösten drar igång är det också ett perfekt tillfälle att blicka framåt – mot nya möjligheter, spännande teknik och nästa steg i karriären. På HiQ tror vi att hösten är tiden då nya idéer tar fart och vår växa. 🍁

Vi är övertygade om att teknik ska vara roligt, enkelt och mänskligt. Vi tror att digitala lösningar kan förändra vardagen för människor – men även att resan dit ska vara fylld av både en stor portion nyfikenhet och viljan att hela tiden bli lite bättre. Vi kombinerar spetskompetens inom IT med en kultur där det finns utrymme för både nyfikenhet och lekfullhet. Hos oss får du bidra med din expertis, växa i din roll och utvecklas tillsammans med kollegor som värdesätter samarbete högt.

Därför söker vi nu en erfaren Data Scientist som vill vara med och skapa framtidens lösningar tillsammans med oss. 🚀

Såhär kommer du att bidra

I rollen som Data Scientist kommer du att designa och utveckla avancerade maskininlärningsmodeller som är både robusta och innovativa, samtidigt som de skapar verkligt affärsvärde. Du kommer att utforska och analysera stora datamängder för att identifiera trender, genomföra statistiska analyser och hypotesprövningar som stöttar strategiska beslut. Din förmåga att översätta komplexa analytiska resultat till tydliga och handlingsbara insikter är avgörande för att driva framgångsrika projekt och skapa nytta för våra kunder.

Vi letar efter dig som…


Har minst 4 års erfarenhet i branschen.
Har erfarenhet av Python och C++
Har goda kunskaper i SQL samt av arbete med stora datamängder.
Erfarenhet av molnplattformar som Azure, AWS eller GCP samt hantering av data lakes, data warehouses och ETL-processer.


Vi ser även positivt på om du har erfarenhet av ML-bibliotek som TensorFlow, PyTorch eller scikit-learn. Du får gärna vara bekant med att integrera Generativ AI i olika lösningar samt har erfarenhet av Retrieval-Augmented Generation och vektordatabaser. Har du dessutom utvecklat och implementerat avancerade modeller inom exempelvis deep learning, såsom CNN, RNN eller transformer-arkitekturer, är detta meriterande.

Därtill ser vi gärna att du har relevant akademisk examen inom t.ex. data science, matematik, statistik, teknisk fysik eller datavetenskap.

Är du vår nästa HiQare?

I Syd har vi kontor i Malmö, Helsingborg och Karlskrona. Om du vill bygga framtidens digitala lösningar, utveckla din kompetens och samtidigt vara en del av ett gäng som tror att skratt, kaffe och kreativitet går hand i hand – då vill vi höra från dig!

👉 Skicka in din ansökan idag och bli en del av HiQ-gemenskapen!

Sist men inte minst!

Vi välkomnar ansökningar från alla - oavsett ålder, könsidentitet eller uttryck, livserfarenhet och bakgrund. Vi tror att mångfald skapar nytänkande och bidrar med fler perspektiv till bordet. Hoppas vi hörs snart!

Title: Data Scientist - vær med til at udvikle prognoser, der holder elnettet i balance
Place: Fredericia, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Data Scientist - vær med til at udvikle prognoser, der holder elnettet i balance

Forestil dig, at din machine learning-model er en del af grundlaget for de beslutninger, der træffes i kontrolcenteret for at sikre strøm til millioner af danskere. I Energinet udvikler vi prognoser og datadrevne beslutningsværktøjer, som bruges til den daglige balancering og drift af det danske elnet. Efterhånden som stadig mere vedvarende energi kobles på systemet, stiger behovet for præcise prognoser, avancerede modeller og intelligent automatisering.

Til vores data science-team søger vi en Data Scientist, der vil være med til at udvikle næste generation af prognoser og machine learning-løsninger til et energisystem i hastig forandring.

Bliv en del af vores specialiserede data science forecasting-team

Vores løsninger anvendes operationelt hver dag og er et vigtigt input til beslutninger om balancering af elsystemet.

Vi er et tværfagligt team bestående af Software Engineers og Data Scientists, der arbejder tæt sammen om at omsætte store datamængder til robuste og driftssikre løsninger. Samtidig indgår vi i et større setup med andre digitale produktteams, hvor samarbejde og videndeling er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Du er med til at udvikle Energinets forecasting-løsninger

Du bliver en central del af arbejdet med at udvikle Energinets forecasting-løsninger, og du kommer bl.a. til at:


Udvikle og forbedre machine learning-modeller til prognoser og beslutningsstøtte
Arbejde med store mængder historiske data og realtidsdata
Omsætte komplekse forretningsbehov til robuste data science-løsninger
Sikre høj kvalitet og stabil drift af modeller i produktion
Samarbejde tæt med specialister, produktfolk og brugere i organisationen
Bidrage til den tekniske retning for teamets data science-løsninger



Samtidig bliver du en del af en spændende udvikling, hvor vi moderniserer vores platforme, udbygger vores arbejde med MLOps og udvikler næste generation af forecasting-løsninger, der skal understøtte fremtidens energisystem.

”Du bliver ikke blot en udførende specialist. Du får også mulighed for at bidrage til både de tekniske løsninger og teamets faglige udvikling,” pointer Lene.

Vi forventer, at du har en længerevarende uddannelse inden for matematik eller data science. Dertil har du flere års erfaring med data science og udvikling af modeller, der skaber værdi i praksis.

Python, herunder Pandas og PySpark
Machine Learning og statistisk modellering
Udvikling og drift af modeller i produktionsmiljøer
Azure, Databricks og Delta Lake
Samarbejde på tværs af teknik og forretning

Glæd dig til at blive en del af en organisation med et meningsfuldt formål, hvor vi forsyner Danmark med el og gas, og omstiller energisystemet til grøn energi.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

Are you a collaborative, analytical, and business-minded Data Scientist who enjoys optimizing complex enterprise systems? Our Deployment Technology team builds the next generation of enterprise tooling to make the migration, configuration, and adoption of Workday features as quick, seamless, and reliable as possible for our customers and implementation partners. We are a dynamic, supportive team that values innovation, continuous delivery, and high-quality data products. If you want to use advanced analytics to help thousands of global enterprises transition smoothly to Workday, we would love to connect with you.

About The Role

Are you a thoughtful, critical thinker who enjoys taking on the unique challenges presented by data migrations and configuration movement across distributed systems?

As a Data Scientist in Deployment Technology, you will look deeply at how our deployment and migration products are performing, identify opportunities for pipeline optimization, and translate complex technical metrics into meaningful narratives.

In this role, you will design living dashboards in Tableau for strategic consumption by leadership, help frame and advocate for our organization's most impactful AI/ML opportunities and mentor team members. You will bridge the gap between our technical stats warehouse and data-driven product decisions, helping our deployment tools scale seamlessly.

What you will do:


Optimize Performance: Analyze product performance, migration logs, and system data to uncover trends and discover opportunities for architectural and workflow improvements.
Explore AI Opportunities: Scope, prioritize, and advocate for our most promising AI and Machine Learning opportunities to introduce intelligent automation into the deployment and data migration lifecycle.
Strategic Visualization: Design, build, and maintain high-impact, living dashboards in Tableau to communicate deployment health and product performance clearly to leadership and engineering stakeholders.
Data Modeling & Exploration: Extract and model data from our stats warehouse and NoSQL environments, utilizing Jupyter Notebooks to prototype predictive models and run advanced statistical analyses.
Drive Informed Decisions: Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering leaders to support product hypotheses with rigorous statistical evidence and data-backed storytelling.
Promote Best Practices: Follow agile methodologies and standard software development practices, contributing to high-quality documentation, robust version control, and rigorous QA for all data products.
Collaborate & Mentor: Cultivate a culture of continuous learning by mentoring team members, sharing technical insights, and collaborating across broader Workday teams.


About You

Basic Qualifications:


5 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, advanced product analytics, or statistical modeling.
5 years of experience utilizing data-focused programming languages and writing advanced SQL queries.
Demonstrated success building and maintaining functional visualization solutions in Tableau.
Strong experience working with Data Warehousing (DW) architectures, stats warehouses, and diverse data lake formats.


Other Qualifications:


Deep understanding of statistics, data modeling, and experimental design (hypothesis testing, regression, time-series).
Practical proficiency with Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or NLP frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, NLTK).
Familiarity with software development lifecycle concepts, including Git source control, Object-Oriented Design (OOD), CI/CD, and Docker containerization.
Strong technical writing and documentation abilities, with a natural talent for explaining complex technical data to non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent interpersonal and team mentoring skills.
Motivated to make a positive, scalable difference with the team and with the company.

Workday pay ranges (and the precise pay offered to the successful candidate) are based on a number of objective criteria such as relevant experience and skills, and educational qualifications, level of responsibility, demands of the role, work location and business need. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants awarded by Workday Inc. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here.

Primary Location Base Pay Range: €66,800 EUR - €100,200 EUR Ireland

Our Approach to Flexible Work

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.

If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
About us

Food waste is a $1 trillion problem - costing the world over 1% of global GDP. We're dead set on solving the problem and looking for people to help us achieve our mission. We, at Winnow, believe that food is far too valuable to waste, and that technology can transform the way we produce food. Our team is made of people who all share a passion for food and technology.

Winnow was founded in London in 2013 to help the hospitality industry prevent food waste through internet of things tools in the kitchen. We have worked with thousands of sites and are operating in over 90 countries around the world supported by our offices in London, Dubai, Singapore, Cluj-Napoca (Romania) and Chicago. We are a scale-up stage company with a strong base of clients who are rolling out our system globally. We have blue-chip customers including Accor Hotels, IKEA, IHG, Marriott, Compass Group and many others.

Winnow's clients on average reduce waste by over 50% by value and sustain savings. Winnow works with hotels, universities and schools, staff restaurants, event/hospitality kitchens, buffets, pubs, and high street restaurants. Where the system is permanently adopted, pre-consumer waste value is reduced by 50% - 70% with no detrimental impact to the perceived quality or value of the offer to their customers. This represents a typical improvement of food cost savings of 3% to 8%, commonly a 40%+ increase in profitability for operations.

As the global leader in addressing food waste, we are committed to continue pushing the envelope on what technology can do to solve this problem. Winnow Vision, our new artificial intelligence-based technology, is trained to automatically track all food waste thrown away. It has won awards at the World Economic Forum and has received tremendous enthusiasm from our clients and the industry. You can read more about it on our website.

Winnow has recently been ranked #4 in the Global FoodTech 500 for 2025, recognising our position among the world's leading innovators at the intersection of food, technology, and sustainability. We have also consistently been recognised in the FoodTech 500, the world's first definitive list of global entrepreneurial talent in this space, further reinforcing our impact in the industry. Other recent accolades include being listed in the 2025 Sunday Times Best Places to Work, a recognition based on feedback from our UK team. While this award is UK-based, it reflects something global: a culture built on purpose, collaboration, and the belief that businesses can - and should - tackle real-world problems while being great places to work. Winnow was also named among Impact 50's most impactful companies to work for. You can read more about it here.

We are passionate about living our values and place them at the centre of everything we do. We are excited about like minded talent who share these values, joining us in our mission:

Equal parts head and heart. We're both passionate and measured. We carefully balance the need for quick solutions and pragmatism with the ability to step back, take in the bigger picture and build for the long term.

Bravely honest. With each other, that means we're a transparent organisation where healthy, respectful debate is encouraged. With our customers, we challenge them if we don't think they're achieving their goals, whether they be environmental or financial.

People of action. Done is better than perfect, and we learn by boldly doing then rapidly improving. We're breaking new ground, so we know things might go wrong. But we judge ourselves and each other on our reaction and our resilience.

Bound by food. We're a diverse bunch, but our belief in the value of food is the common thread in everything we do. With each other, we celebrate through our love and respect for food. With our customers, it means we work hard to develop creative tools to make it easy for chefs to value food.

Hungry and humble. Our product is revolutionary, our people are impressive, and we're hungry for change. But, we're just the catalyst for a bigger movement. We stay humble regardless of our success, and make chefs the heroes in this journey.

People and planet positive. We're caretakers of the planet, helping to preserve and support it for now and the future. Our work already minimises the impact that the hospitality industry has on the planet, and we're also committed to actively reducing our own footprint while doing so. We're leaving the planet and its people better off than we found them.

This is an opportunity to join an exciting organisation and help us propel our growth at what are truly the most exciting and dynamic points in time in our business. You will work alongside a driven team who are motivated by building an exciting business and leaving the world a better place than we found it.

Title: Data scientist (m/f) - A1
HTML:
Informations générales

  • Statut: Employé de l'État

  • Groupe d'indemnité: A1

  • Nombre de postes vacants: 1

  • Nationalité: Être ressortissant UE

  • Catégorie de métiers: Technologie de l'information et de la communication

Qui recrute ?

L’Administration des Contributions Directes (ACD) recherche un Data Scientist pour son Département Données, Analyses, et IA. Le candidat contribuera à renforcer la détection des risques liés aux réglementations fiscales, en développant des solutions innovantes pour automatiser la conformité, optimiser les processus fiscaux et soutenir la prise de décision stratégique.

Missions

  • Analyser des données administratives complexes (non conçues pour l’analyse) pour en extraire des insights actionnables;

  • Participer au développement et maintenance de pipelines de données pour valoriser des données internes et externes;

  • Concevoir et maintenir des applications analytiques (ex : Dataiku, streamlit , QLIK) pour cibler les fraudes ou soutenir les décisions;

  • Collaborer avec les équipes métiers pour traduire leurs besoins en solutions data (ex : modèles de segmentation, outils de compliance);

  • Innover avec de nouvelles technologies (intelligence artificielle) tout en garantissant leur usage approprié.

Profil

Compétences techniques

  • Savoir développer des applications Data/IA en Python : code modulaire, testable, et déployable en production (bonnes pratiques DevOps);

  • Expérience en traitement de données avec python, SQL / VQL (virtualisation des données) pour nettoyer, lier et analyser des datasets structurés et non structurés;

  • Expérience en analyse de séries temporelles, en optimisation mathématique, et des modèles de simulation;

  • Savoir utiliser des techniques statistiques, Machine Learning, et IA générative pour découvrir des relations cachées;

  • Expérience démontrée en traduction de problèmes métiers (ex : fraude, compliance) en solutions data/IA;

  • Savoir définir des MVPs (Minimum Viable Product) prioriser les livrables et travailler avec une approche « build – measure - learn »;

  • Savoir expliquer des concepts techniques à des non-experts (ex : présenter un modèle de détection de fraude à des agents fiscaux);

  • Savoir choisir la bonne technologie pour communiquer et visualiser des résultats.

Compétences comportementales

  • Rigueur, autonomie, pédagogie et collaboration multidisciplinaire;

  • Adaptabilité aux évolutions réglementaires et technologiques;

  • Motivation et capacité d’apprentissage rapide pour maîtriser les spécificités fiscales internationales.

Atouts

  • Une exposition à un environnement fiscal ou réglementé (finance, assurance, administration publique) est un atout clé pour ce rôle;

  • Connaissance des enjeux de transparence fiscale internationale et des outils associés;

  • Maitrise courante de l’anglais.

Conditions d’admission

Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut de l'employé de l'État.

Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission pour devenir employé de l'État.

Diplômes

Vous êtes titulaire d’un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d’enseignement supérieur reconnu par l’État du siège de l’établissement et sanctionnant l’accomplissement avec succès d’un master en informatique, mathématiques, data science ou de son équivalent.

Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications.

Expérience

Vous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans dans le domaine.

Langues

Vous répondez aux exigences des connaissances de 3 langues administratives pour le groupe d'indemnité A1. Une dispense de deux des trois langues administratives peut être accordée sous certaines conditions.

Nationalité

Vous êtes ressortissant d’un État membre de l’Union européenne.

Documents à fournir

Lettre de motivation, copie du diplôme, CV



  • Pour ce poste, vous devez obligatoirement postuler en ligne via MyGuichet, les candidatures via courriel ou via courrier postal n’étant pas acceptées. Les documents sont à introduire via MyGuichet en format pdf (taille maximale 20 Mo).

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
At myPOS, we’re all about helping businesses grow and get paid. We make payments simple, smart, and accessible for everyone, but we’re more than just payment solutions - myPOS is a partner in growth. From free multicurrency accounts to powerful e-commerce tools, we’re here to support business owners of all sizes and everyone out there who dreams of starting their own business.

As we are expanding our team, we’re looking for Data Scientist to help us make a real difference in the Fintech industry. Ready to join us and shape the future of payments? Let’s make it happen!

About the role:

myPOS is building a high-impact Data Science function to power the intelligence layer of one of Europe’s fastest-growing payment and commerce platforms. As a Data Scientist, you will contribute to a focused team working across a rich portfolio of models that drive smarter decisions in Sales, Marketing, Risk, Operations, Product and Technology.

You will move fluidly across problem types: from customer lifetime value and churn modelling to fraud scoring and agentic AI workflows.

What you’ll do:


Build and maintain ML models across the core portfolio: CLTV, churn prediction, propensity to buy, and Next Most Likely Product (NMLP)
Develop fraud detection models including transaction-level classifiers, merchant behaviour anomaly detectors, and new-account risk scorers
Contribute scored model outputs to the Next Best Action (NBA) decisioning layer that selects the optimal action for each merchant across Sales, Marketing, and in-product touchpoints
Support A/B experiments, uplift tests, and multi-armed bandit evaluations to measure the incremental impact of model-driven interventions
Design and implement end-to-end ML pipelines — from data ingestion and feature engineering through to model training, evaluation, and deployment
Monitor deployed models in production: detect performance degradation, data drift, and data quality issues; iterate and document changes proactively
Collaborate with business teams across Sales, Marketing, Risk, Operations, and Product to translate business problems into well-defined data science solutions
Run rigorous experiments and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Contribute to LLM-powered agentic workflows using tool-use patterns (RAG, function calling, memory) and frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex
Contribute to team documentation: model cards, methodology write-ups, and internal playbooks that help the team scale its practices


This role is perfect for you if you have:


3–5 years of hands-on applied data science, machine learning or statistical modelling experience in a commercial setting, with models shipped and measured in production.
Strong proficiency in Python for data science: pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, XGBoost / LightGBM, and at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow).
Solid grounding in supervised and unsupervised learning: classification, regression, clustering, survival analysis, and time-series modelling.
Demonstrable experience building at least one of: CLTV, churn, fraud detection, propensity, or uplift models in a production environment.
Comfort working with large-scale structured and semi-structured data; proficient in SQL and cloud data warehouses - GCP and BigQuery strongly preferred.
Familiarity with ML experiment tracking platforms (MLflow, Weights & Biases) and model serving patterns (REST APIs, batch inference pipelines).
Working knowledge of LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and at least one agentic AI framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or similar).
Understanding of responsible AI: fairness assessment, model explainability methods (SHAP, LIME), bias detection and mitigation strategies.
Clear communication — able to distil statistical findings into actionable insights for both technical peers and business stakeholders.


Nice to have:


Experience in fintech, payments, banking or e-commerce
Familiarity with workflow orchestration (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster)
Exposure to causal inference methods (DiD, IV, PSM)
Experience building or fine-tuning LLMs, RAG pipelines, or tool-use agents
Knowledge of graph-based fraud detection techniques
Exposure to streaming feature engineering (Kafka, Pub-Sub, Spark)


Why you should join myPOS:


Vibrant international team operating in hi-tech environment
Annual salary reviews, promotions and performance bonuses
myPOS Academy for upskilling and training
Unlimited access to courses on LinkedIn Learning
Annual individual training and development budget
Refer a friend bonus as we know that working with friends is fun
Teambuilding, social activities and networks on a multi-national level


What we offer:


Excellent compensation package
25 days annual paid leave (+1 day per year up to 30)
Full “Luxury” package health insurance including dental care and optical glasses
Meal vouchers of 102.26 EUR per month
Fully covered Multisport card
Fully covered public transport pass for Sofia
Free coffee, snacks and drinks at the office


Who we are:

Since 2014 we’ve been all about making payments easier and more accessible for businesses of all shapes and sizes. Whether you’re at the counter, selling online, or on the move, we’ve got businesses covered with smart, accessible and affordable solutions that keep things easy.

Our mission? It’s simple. Help businesses get paid by taking advantage of modern tech and innovative ideas, so payment challenges are a thing of the past.

Pro tip:

Take it easy about meeting every requirement - this job description is just that, a job description! Even if you don’t tick every box, we want you to apply anyway! This is your chance to grow, learn, and build your career with us. We value potential over perfection, and we are all about mutual growth!

Apply by filling in the form below and send your CV in English!

myPOS is committed to providing equal employment opportunities. All qualified candidates will be considered for employment without discrimination based on age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, veteran status, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Your application will be confidentially reviewed in line with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Personal information will be used solely for the job application and will be stored for a period needed by the application process. Only short-listed candidates will be contacted. Good luck!

Title: Full Stack Data Scientist
Description:
Are you a Full Stack Data Scientist driven by turning data into tangible business results? Do you want to help organizations become more productive and competitive?

Vuono Group is now looking for Full Stack Data Scientists to join our growing team of experts in Helsinki. Vuono Group is a consultancy that drives business value with processes and AI. We empower Nordic organisations in both the private and public sectors to bridge the gap between business needs and AI capabilities, enabling smarter decision-making, increased operational efficiency, and accelerated growth.

About The Role

As a Full Stack Data Scientist, you are interested in what happens under the hood of modern data solutions and data architectures. You care about data quality, usability and the value it can provide for various business processes. You're experienced with data science and engineering practices, including data observability, implementing MLOps (maybe even LLMOps) workflows and real-time data processing. You understand the intersection of ML/AI systems and data engineering and can build scalable pipelines that support both analytical and operational use cases. Experience with cloud-native data architectures (e.g. Azure, AWS, GCP) is essential.

At Vuono Group, you will get to work in a cross-competence team making our clients' businesses more intelligent with data. In practice, this means building data pipelines, integrating systems together, and utilising ML and AI for insights and operational use cases.

What We’re Looking For


Experience in planning and building production level data solutions that solve real business problems
An analytical mindset and problem-solving skills
Machine learning modeling and/or natural language processing experience
Experience in designing and implementing end-to-end data pipelines that transform raw operational data into business-ready information products
Experience in running and monitoring production workloads
Programming experience in Python and SQL
Willingness and readiness to learn and operate with new technology platforms, tools, whether low code like Celonis or Fabric or pro code like new cloud infrastructure
MSc degree in Machine Learning, Data Science and Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or similar
Professional-level Finnish and English language proficiency


The Following Is Considered a Plus


Interest in continuously learning and applying new technologies and platforms; generative AI, RAG, AI Agents, among others
Experience with various tech stacks, e.g. AWS Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, DBT, Apache Kafka, Terraform, or similar
Experience in utilising data from business technology platforms, such as ERP, CRM or similar (SAP, Salesforce, ServiceNow, etc.)
Experience in transforming data for process and content intelligence purposes
Previous consulting experience


You don’t need to tick every box! What matters most is your drive to make a real impact!

What We Offer

We are building the best work environment for data, AI and business process professionals. To get there, we invest in the well-being and work-life balance as well as the professional development of our people. We operate on trust and transparency rather than titles, fostering a high-autonomy, growth-oriented environment where collaboration, impact, and everyone’s unique thoughts and ideas are valued.

In addition to the usual perks, such as work tools of your choice and extensive healthcare benefits, we also offer our employees the opportunity to invest in our rapidly growing company via an employee share program.

Work with Leading Nordic Companies

Title: Full Stack Data Scientist
Description:
Millaisesta työstä sinä innostuisit juuri nyt?




Olisiko työn haastettava ja kehitettävä taitojasi? Tulisiko sen tuottaa tunne, että olet tekemässä jotain merkittävää? Haluaisitko työskennellä työyhteisössä, jossa välittäminen näkyy jokapäiväisissä teoissa ja kohtaamisissa?




Mitä jos sanoisimme, että meillä työskennellessäsi nämä kaikki seikat yhdistyvät yhdeksi – sinun erinomaiseksi työntekijäkokemukseksesi.




🚀 Lyhyt kuvaus työstäsi Full Stack Data Scientistina

Kanssamme luot asiakkaillemme liiketoiminnallista arvoa ja konkreettista kilpailuetua auttamalla heitä tekemään parempia päätöksiä datan avulla.




Konsultoit, kehität ja viet eteenpäin innovaatioita, jotka auttavat yrityksiä ja yhteisöjä toimimaan fiksusti ja ketterästi. Teet monimutkaisesta yksinkertaista uusimmilla teknologioilla, tehokkaimmilla laskentatavoilla ja parhailla käytännöillä.




Teknologisesta näkökulmasta erilaiset tietovarastot, laskentaympäristöt ja datankäsittelytyökalut ovat osa arkeasi siinä missä pilvipalvelut (AWS, ja Azure ja GCP) sekä ohjelmointikielet ovat erottamaton osa työtäsi.




Vielä lisää konkretiaa

Olemme ylpeitä, kuinka jatkuva oppiminen on luonnollinen osa nitorilaisten päivittäistä asiakasprojektissa työskentelyä. Lue Data Scientistimme, Tuukka Stewenin oppimismatkasta.

Täältä pääset tutustumaan Finnairille toteuttamaamme operatiivisen toiminnan työkaluun.

Data Scientistimme ja projektissa mukana ollut tuleva työkaverisi Jukka kertoo kokemuksiansa projektista ja meillä työskentelystä täällä.

Miltä dataosaajamme työpäivä näyttää – käy vilkaisemassa Eeron tarina.




🤝 Dataliiketoimintamme on yksi kasvualueistamme




Meillä on kokemusta ja osaamista merkittävien toimeksiantojen toteuttamiseen. Asiakastyytyväisyytemme on huippuluokkaa ja kehitämme jatkuvasti toimintaamme.




Katseemme on myös vahvasti tulevassa. Kun tulet työkaveriksemme, uskomme, että se vie meitä taas askeleen eteenpäin – samalla kun katsomme sinulle uraasi ja kehittymistäsi tukevat toimeksiannot, joissa työskentelet yhdessä toisten nitorilaisten kanssa. Meillä saat toteuttaa näköistäsi työelämää yhteiseen tulevaisuuteemme vaikuttaen.




Tuleva data-asiantuntijoiden tiimisi on tiivis startup-henkinen ja uuden oppimista arvostava, jolta löytyy poikkeuksellisen korkeatasoista dataosaamista. Ja jos palaset loksahtavat kohdalleen, tätä joukkoa sinä täydennät juuri sellaisena kuin olet.




✅ Mitä sinä voisit tuoda mukanasi?




Tässä tehtävässä loistat, kun sinulla on ohjelmointikokemusta, kyky kehittää koodia modernein menetelmin sekä matemaattisen ajattelun mentaliteetti ja taito. Olet kiinnostunut tekoälystä ja koneoppimisesta. Koska ala menee eteenpäin vauhdilla, on tärkeää, että olet innostunut uuden omaksumisesta ja näet haasteet mahdollisuuksina.




Mitä enemmän sinulla on osaamista, se luonnollisesti tarjoaa enemmän mahdollisuuksia heti ensimetreistäsi lähtien. Emme kuitenkaan halua liian tarkkaan määrittää tässä kohtaa, millainen sinun tulisi olla. Palaset kun voivat loksahtaa kohdalleen niin monella tapaa.




🏆Mitä jos valitsisitkin meidät?

Me uskomme, että rekrytoinnissa ei ole kyse siitä, että yritys valitsee uuden työntekijän. Sinä lopulta teet valinnan. Ja me voimme sinua siinä auttaa.




Sinun kannattaa olla meihin yhteydessä, jos

haluat työskennellä mielekkäiden toimeksiantojen parissa relevantteja, uusia asioita oppien.
rinnallasi työskentelevät osaavat kollegat, erinomaiset kouluttautumismahdollisuudet sekä optimaaliset työolosuhteet ja -välineet ovat sinulle tärkeitä asioita.
koet, että yhteisöllisyys ja toisille hyvän tahtominen ovat työelämässä merkityksellisiä arvoja.
sinusta on ihan ok tehdä normityöaikaa ja huolehtia, että vapaat ja työt pysyvät balanssissa.
työskentelet mielelläsi pitkäaikaisissa asiakkuuksissa projektista toiseen poukkoilun sijaan.




Työskentelyäsi ja arkeasi tukevat meillä myös muuten hyvin monimuotoiset edut ja mahdollisuudet:




Voit esimerkiksi käyttää 10 % työajastasi ammatilliseen kehittymiseen.
Palkitsemme suorittamasi sertifikaatit bonuksin (500–2000 €/sertifikaatti).
Saat käyttöösi 7100 € työvälineiden hankkimiseen.
Sinulla on mahdollisuus palkalliseen lomaan heti meillä aloitettuasi.
Lisäksi meillä on kattavat henkilöstöedut ja innostavaa yhteistä ajanviettoa.




⭐ Haluaisitko jutella kanssamme tarkemmin, mitä me voisimme sinulle tarjota?

Liity nyt data-ammattilaistemme, koodareidemme, suunnittelijoidemme ja valmentajiemme joukkoon työskentelemään luovassa sekä byrokratiavapaassa työkulttuurissa.




Olisimme todella innostuneita kuulemaan sinusta lisää. Kerro, millaista askelta olet urallasi ottamassa, ja katsotaan, miten me voisimme sinua auttaa.




❓Onko mielessäsi kysymyksiä? Pohdituttaako jokin seikka?

Lähetä meille viesti niin People Partnerimme Ella Raskila (ella.raskila@nitor.com) vastaa kaikkiin kysymyksiisi ja auttaa sinua. Varmistetaan, että saat kaiken tarvitsemasi tiedon sinulle tärkeän päätöksen tekemiseksi.




👥 Me kuuntelemme sinua

Me haluamme tarjota työntekijöillemme parhaan mahdollisen työpaikan ja tukea sinun osaamisesi kehittymistä. Nitorilla juuri sinä, ainutlaatuiset taitosi ja henkilökohtaiset kiinnostuksen kohteesi määrittävät urasi suunnan.

Kiehtovat projektit, luontainen uteliaisuutemme ja kollegojesi tuki motivoivat sinua jatkuvassa oppimisessa. Osallistut mielenkiintoisiin koulutuksiin, tapahtumiin ja konferensseihin. Lisäksi voit käyttää osan työajastasi uuden oppimiseen, yhteisömme kehittämiseen sekä sinua inspiroiviin pro bono –projekteihin.

Meillä urapolkusi ei ole ennalta määrätty – päinvastoin, kannustamme sinua tutkimaan kiinnostuksen kohteitasi ilman turhaa hierarkiaa ja byrokratiaa. Nitorilla äänesi kuuluu.




🎯 Lyhyesti Nitorista – toivottavasti sinunkin tulevasta työpaikastasi

Jokainen nitorilainen on pragmaattinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen tiimipelaaja, joka ei tyydy oletuksiin. Meille ominaista ovat todella korkea ammattitaito ja ylpeys niin omasta kuin kollegoidemmekin työstä.

Yli 250 asiantuntijaamme toimivat Helsingissä, Tampereella ja Tukholmassa, yhdistäen monipuoliset osaamisensa merkityksellisten vaikutusten saavuttamiseksi. Olemme ylpeitä työntekijälähtöisestä kulttuuristamme ja aidosta sitoutumisestamme ihmistemme kasvuun – tunnustuksena tästä meidät on palkittu Great Place to Work -sertifikaatilla sekä valittu Suomen vetovoimaisimmaksi työnantajabrändiksi.




Visiomme on selkeä: olla alan halutuin työpaikka, jossa menestys syntyy työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden hyvinvoinnista ja tyytyväisyydestä. Jatkamme kasvuamme IT-alan asiakastyytyväisyyden suunnannäyttäjänä tuottaen erinomaista lisäarvoa asiakkaillemme (lue, miten ainutlaatuinen asiakaskokemus ruokkii kasvuamme).

Title: Medior Data Scientist / ML Engineer
Description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving

Sopra Steria biedt op maat gemaakte end-to-end corporate technology- en softwareoplossingen die organisaties helpen gedurfde keuzes te maken en meetbare resultaten te boeken. Met meer dan 51.000 collega’s in bijna 30 landen behoren we tot de top van de Europese leveranciers van digitale oplossingen. Succesvolle organisaties in Europa vertrouwen op onze technologie vanwege onze voortdurende focus op innovatie, samenwerking en zakelijke ontwikkeling. The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

Vacatureomschrijving

Je kan waardevolle inzichten halen uit grote datasets. Als Data Scientist ontfutsel je deze door je vloeiend kennis van programmeertalen als Python en R en visualisatietools als Tableau en PowerBI. Je kan die inzichten communiceren naar stakeholders zodat ze de nodige stappen kunnen zetten. Onze data scientists zijn vaardig in Hadoop & Spark en cloudplatformen als AWS en Azure. Deze tools – samen met je data expertise – zorgen ervoor dat het bouwen van voorspellende modellen, het uitvoeren van hypothesis tests en het uitvoeren van verkennende data-analyse je heel natuurlijk af gaan.

Als Data Engineer zal je:


ruwe data omzetten in bruikbare inzichten en
schaalbare oplossingen
je richten op het ontwerp en de optimalisatie
van data-infrastructuur
processen automatiseren
zorgen voor een naadloze levering van data
microservices ontwikkelen om data lakes
toegankelijker en nuttiger te maken


Je zoekt steeds naar innovatieve manieren om de schaalbaarheid en bruikbaarheid van data te verbeteren. Van de eerste conceptontwikkeling tot de uiteindelijke implementatie—jij ontwikkelt en implementeert data oplossingen die sterke resultaten opleveren en de strategische doelen van onze klanten ondersteunen.

Functie-eisen

We zijn op zoek naar gepassioneerde collega’s die graag de grenzen willen verleggen op het gebied van digitale transformatie en technologie consulting. Bij Sopra Steria krijg je de kans om te werken aan impactvolle projecten en je vaardigheden te ontwikkelen in een constructieve teamomgeving. Jij wilt tot de besten behoren. Dat is waarom jij altijd naar manieren zoekt om jouw kennis uit te breiden en op de hoogte te blijven van de laatste trends en ontwikkelingen. Hou je van een uitdaging en vind je jezelf in (de meeste van) deze criteria? Dan kijken we nu al uit naar jouw sollicitatie.

Type werk: Hybrid

Locatie: Groningen, NL

Contracturen: 36-40

Type contract: Vast

Opleiding: HBO, WO, PhD

Ervaring: 3-4 jaar

Talen: Nederlands

Je hebt kennis van of ervaring in:

Need: Python, SQL, cloud platform (Azure, AWS, GCP), git, docker

Nice to have: BI, R, Databricks, wiskundige optimalisatie, Specialisatie(e.g. Tabular ML, Computer vision, NLP, Deep Learning), MLOps/devOps, Verantwoorde AI kennis, big data/distributed computing, ETL/ELT, Presentatie vaardigheden

Je zal deel uitmaken van een grote naam in de tech wereld die bekend is om consulting, digitale diensten en softwareontwikkeling. Je begeeft je tussen high-level professionals die durven in te zetten om hoge resultaten te behalen.

Aanvullende informatie

Je zal deel uitmaken van een grote naam in de tech wereld die bekend is om consulting, digitale diensten en softwareontwikkeling. Je begeeft je tussen high-level professionals die durven in te zetten om hoge resultaten te behalen.

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:


Een vast contract.
Een vast contract;
Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol;
Vakantiegeld van 8%;
Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten;

Title: Data Scientist
HTML:
Als Data Scientist lever je inzichten uit gegevens door het analyseproces te optimaliseren en visuele gegevensrepresentaties te presenteren. Je zoekt, beheert en voegt meerdere gegevensbronnen samen en zorgt voor consistentie van gegevenssets. Je identificeert de wiskundige modellen, selecteert en optimaliseert de algoritmen om bedrijfswaarde te leveren door middel van inzichten. Je stelt patronen vast en beveelt manieren aan om gegevens toe te passen.


Waarom past deze vacature bij jou?

Jij wilt jezelf blijven ontwikkelen en dat zit in ons DNA! Met jouw inzicht in cijfers, data en techniek leg je elke complexiteit simpel uit aan de klant. Klanttevredenheid is belangrijk voor je, dus je luistert goed en geeft inzichtelijke antwoorden die de klant het vertrouwen geeft dat het probleem wordt opgelost. Aan de hand van de informatiebehoefte van jouw stakeholders ontwikkel, test en implementeer je data science-modellen en help je collega’s om de mogelijkheden die schuilen in de rijke data bij onze gerenommeerde klanten, optimaal te benutten. Natuurlijk houd je daarbij de ontwikkelingen in het vak goed in de gaten. Krijg jij energie van het ontdekken van nieuwe kansen met data science? Je voelt je thuis in een informele, collegiale en professionele sfeer waar de aandacht voor de klant en voor de medewerker centraal staan.


Wat kun jij van ons verwachten?

  • Naast een dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd, een max. salaris van € 8.000, bonusregeling, leaseauto, pensioenregeling en maandelijkse onkostenvergoeding;
  • € 5.000,- opleidingsbudget en daarnaast 5-10 dagen studietijd;
  • Kennissessies met andere SIG Data Analytics en Competence Center Data Analyse, Big data en BI;
  • 25 vakantiedagen en snel oplopend tot 28 vakantiedagen per jaar;
  • Het aan- of verkopen van vakantiedagen;
  • Regelmatig sociale uitjes zoals sportdagen, weekendjes weg en gezellige borrels.


Jouw ontwikkeling, onze prioriteit

We bieden jou persoonlijke ontwikkeling aan en zo werk je aan jouw carrière. Learn, create and make it work is niet alleen onze slogan, maar is ons DNA. Als Data Scientist kun je doorgroeien naar diverse rollen, zoals Data Science Consultant, Business Analist, Senior Consultant.


CIMSOLUTIONS heeft een actief diversiteitsbeleid en streeft naar een evenwichtige verdeling van professionals naar o.a. leeftijd, gender, etnische achtergrond en cultuur, arbeidsvermogen, kennis en competenties. Hierbij benadrukken wij dat wij gelijke kansen belangrijk vinden in de selectie.


Wat breng jij mee?

  • Minimaal een afgeronde WO-Masters opleiding met een sterk ICT-component
  • Ervaring met het structureren en analyseren van grote hoeveelheden data om daarin relevante inzichten te ontdekken;
  • Kennis van artificial intelligence, predictive analysis of Deepen/of Machine learning (libraries zoals TensorFlow, Keras, sklearn, Caffe, Torch);
  • Kennis van en ervaring met één of meerdere analytics tools zoals R, Spark, Storm, HIVE, QlikView, Power BI, Splunk, MatLab, of SAS Suite etc.;
  • Kennis van en ervaring met databasetechnologieën (Hadoop, SQL NoSQL, NewSQL etc.);
  • Ervaring met het visualiseren van data met behulp van de laatste state-of-the-art technologieën;
  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in zowel Nederlands als Engels.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem
ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments

As a Data Scientist you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!

The purpose of the Data Scientist role is:
Designs, develops and programs methods, processes, and systems to consolidate and analyze unstructured, diverse “big data” sources to generate actionable insights and solutions for client services and product enhancement. Interacts with product and service teams to identify questions and issues for data analysis and experiments. Develops and codes software programs, algorithms and automated processes to cleanse, integrate and evaluate large datasets from multiple disparate sources. Identifies meaningful insights from large data and metadata sources; interprets and communicates insights and findings from analysis and experiments to product, service, and business managers.

A typical day at ACI for a Data Scientist is:
- Develops predictive models for customers utilizing a variety of statistical and machine learning algorithms.
- Holds responsibility for projects of a moderate degree of complexity and very large volume datasets.
- Executes all stages of model development and delivery including data definition, sampling, preprocessing, feature selection, model generation, and validation and support or production model release.
- Validates and prepares data for model development, performs exploratory data analysis and data cleaning on large datasets and queries and visualizes data with a variety of tools.
- Works collaboratively with a team of scientists and engineers responsible for the development and deployment of the state-of-the-art models for a variety of financial applications.
- This includes the design, development and deployment of models that leverage large datasets containing structured and unstructured data.
- Perform other duties as assigned.
- Understand and adhere to all corporate policies to include but not limited to the ACI Code of Business Conduct and Ethics.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience needed to succeed in this role:
- Bachelor’s degree required. PhD preferred in Bioinformatics, Electrical Engineering, Applied Statistical Mathematics, Physics, Computational Chemistry or related field
- 2+ years industry or related field experience
- Experience in development of computational software (basic level with Python, pySPARK, R, SQL)
- Knowledge of AI base tools to accelerate coding and implement projects

Core Capabilities:
We seek colleagues who embody our core capabilities — these shape our culture and enable us to make a meaningful impact together:
- Ensure Accountability: holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
- Drives Results: consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
- Customer Focus: building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
- Cultivate Innovation: creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful.
- Collaborates: building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
- Courage: stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the Romania on a full-time basis. This position does not offer sponsorship for employment visa status or work permit now or in the future.
I n return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.
Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com
ACI Worldwide is an AA/EEO employer in the United States, which includes providing equal opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities, and an EEO employer globally.
Important Notice About Recruitment Scams
Job seekers should be aware of ongoing recruitment scams where individuals or organizations impersonate legitimate companies to offer fake job opportunities. These scams often involve requests for personal information, payments, or interviews through unofficial channels. Please be cautious and verify any communications claiming to be from our company ( www.aciworldwide.com / @aciworldwide.com). The ACI Worldwide recruitment team will always follow official channels and will never request payment.

Title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
Description:
Testo, with its headquarters in the Black Forest/Germany, is a world market leader in the field of portable and stationary measurement technology. Worldwide, roughly 3900 employees research, develop, produce and market innovative measurement solutions for Testo. The basis for this success, in addition to the highly qualified and motivated staff, is the above-average commitment to a future-oriented development - roughly 10% of the annual concern turnover is invested in Research & Development. With 37 subsidiary companies and over 80 distribution partners, Testo is represented on all five continents.

Role Description

As part of our commitment to leveraging data and AI to drive business value, we are seeking a curious and motivated Data Scientist to join our team.

In this key role, you will transform data into actionable insights, develop machine learning models, and help build the foundation for AI-driven decision-making across the organization. You will work closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to solve complex challenges and support Testo's data transformation journey.

Data Science & Modelling


Collect, explore, and analyze data from various business domains to uncover meaningful patterns and trends.
Build, validate, and iterate on statistical and machine learning models that address real business questions.
Apply techniques such as regression, classification, clustering, and time-series forecasting to a variety of use cases.
Translate model outputs into clear, actionable insights, making the complex understandable.


Business Collaboration & Insight Delivery


Work closely with teams across finance, operations, sales, and supply chain to understand their data needs and business context.
Act as a translator between data and business: listen to the business problem, find the right analytical approach, and present findings that stakeholders can act on.
Build dashboards and reports that make insights accessible and self-serviceable for non-technical users.


AI Enablement


Contribute to making our data platform AI-ready — helping to ensure that data is clean, structured, and accessible for AI tools and agents.
Support the development of interfaces (API or MCP server) that allow AI assistants and LLM-based tools to access business data reliably.
Explore and prototype AI/GenAI use cases together with the business and IT teams.


Continuous Learning & Data Culture


Stay up to date with developments in data science, machine learning, and AI - and bring new ideas into the team.
Help establish best practices for data usage and analytics across the organization.
Actively contributes to a culture where data is trusted, understood, and used to make better decisions.


What We Offer


A meaningful and impact-driven role at the heart of Testo's data transformation journey.
The opportunity to work with modern analytics and AI technologies in an international environment.
A collaborative, learning-oriented culture with room for professional development.
Flexible working arrangements and a supportive team atmosphere.
Competitive remuneration and a comprehensive benefits package.


Your Profile

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Business Informatics, or a related field.

Must-Have Experience


2-5 years of professional experience in Data Science or a related analytical field.
Strong hands-on experience with machine learning and statistical modelling.
Proven experience collecting, cleaning, exploring, and analyzing complex business datasets.
Experience presenting analytical findings to non-technical stakeholders and translating data into business value.


Nice-to-Have Experience


Experience with cloud data platforms or modern data stacks
Exposure to AI/GenAI use cases or LLM-based applications in a business context.
Experience in an SAP environment (SAP Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, or similar) can be learned on the job.


Languages: Very good command of written and spoken English.

Personal Attributes


Genuinely curious about data and passionate about finding the story behind the numbers.
A fast learner who picks up new tools, technologies, and domains quickly — and enjoys doing so.
Strong communicator who can explain complex analytical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Business-minded: able to understand the "why" behind a question, not just the "how" of solving it.
Collaborative and open, thriving in cross-functional teams and an international environment.
Proactive and self-driven — comfortable working with ambiguity and taking initiative.


You would like to know more about our job vacancy? Please get in touch with Frau Ana Mauricio email: recrutamento@testo.pt.

We are looking forward to receiving your application via Online-Portal.

Title: Data Scientist - Trust & Safety
Description:
Responsibilities
About the Team
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form video. Our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy.

The Trust & Safety team at TikTok helps ensure that our global community is safe and empowered to create and enjoy content across all of our applications. We have invested heavily in policy making, product development, and human and automatic moderation to protect billions of users around the globe from harmful content and abusive behaviors.

The mission of data science is to help Trust & Safety make many good decisions using data. As a member of our team, you are instrumental in ensuring that we use data to keep our users and community safe. You will help scope out projects, ideate on new strategies, and most importantly, use data to find insights, diagnose problems and tell compelling stories. You will partner with a variety of stakeholders across operations, policy, product and engineering teams - both locally and globally.

What You Will do:
- Work with large and complex data sets to support project execution and strategic planning
- Design and monitor core metrics; perform root cause analysis to explain drivers
- Collaborate closely with the global Trust and Safety team, proactively providing insights and recommendations and overseeing the macro direction of the business
- Influence stakeholders through data-based recommendations and mobilize cross-functional teams by telling compelling stories with data to drive business impact and innovative breakthrough
- Use data and insights to form best-in-class heuristics to proactively detect and disarm safety incidents
- Develop metrics and visualization tools to evaluate risks of the platform and the impact of safety strategies

Qualifications
Minimum Qualification(s)
- 5+ years of experience in data science, analytics or quantitative analysis
- Experience working with SQL, ETL, R/Python, Tableau, Excel
- Experience building data infrastructure and implementing reporting solutions
- Experience with creating data visualizations to communicate metric performance
- Independently design, research, develop and apply ML/AI solutions to solve business problems, including prediction, optimization, segmentation and so on. Build evaluation systems for outputs to minimise error and bias and identify root causes such as limitations with model's training data / context window.
- Ability to solve problems using quantitative approaches, strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences to communicate complex concepts and analytical results to drive business impact, and proficiency in English as a working language
- Degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering)

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Experience of working in online content platforms, Trust & Safety or risk management
- Experience working with international partners in different time zones
- Demonstrated experience using AI tools and emerging technologies to generate insights, improve workflows and develop new capabilities
- Passion for social technology products and a curiosity to learn and grow with a fast paced company

Trust & Safety
Content that this role interacts with includes images, video, and text related to every-day life, but it can also include (but is not limited to) bullying; hate speech; child safety; depictions of harm to self and others, and harm to animals. Hence, it is possible that this role will be exposed to harmful content on a daily basis. ​
​
TikTok recognises that keeping our platform safe for the TikTok communities is no ordinary job which can be both rewarding and psychologically demanding and emotionally taxing for some. This is why we are sharing the potential hazards, risks and implications in this unique line of work from the start, so our candidates are well informed before joining. ​
​
We are committed to the wellbeing of all our employees and promise to provide comprehensive and evidence-based programs, to promote and support physical and mental wellbeing throughout each employee's journey with us. We believe that wellbeing is a relationship and that everyone has a part to play, so we work in collaboration and consultation with our employees and across our functions in order to ensure a truly person-centred, innovative and integrated approach.​


About TikTok
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​


Why Join Us
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

Title: Data Scientist (m/f/d)
Description:
We’re the world’s leading sports technology company, at the intersection between sports, media, and betting. More than 1,700 sports federations, media outlets, betting operators, and consumer platforms across 120 countries rely on our know-how and technology to boost their business.





Job Description



ABOUT US:

Reporting to the Head of Quants you will be working closely with your colleagues in Quants but also various product owners, developers and traders company wide. Our department is responsible for creating predictive models for both pre-match and in-play betting markets in various sports. This typically requires cleaning up, visualizing, analyzing and interpreting relevant data, as well as implementing the created models in Java and testing them. Publishing and maintaining these Java libraries is also one of our responsibilities. Furthermore, we are providing various data analysis or generally math related tasks on demand.







THE CHALLENGE:



Learn how predictive models look like in a betting context and build models on your own.
Support the team in maintaining the codebase.
Analyze/evaluate/optimize existing predictive models as model co-owner.
Research new methods for future applications.





ABOUT YOU:



Required:



Master’s degree or equivalent/higher qualification in one of the following disciplines: Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Software Engineering or a closely related field.
Experienced in predictive modelling, with a deep understanding of data analysis and modelling techniques such as GLMs, Time-Series Analysis, Bayesian Statistics, MCMC, neural networks, etc.
Very strong skills in R or python.
Advanced coding and analytical skills.
Strong communication skills, fluency in English.
Creative thinking, keen to further refine systems and processes.
Highly self-motivated, leading by example and enthusiasm.
Being a team player, with the ability to work with new teams immediately.
Strong interpersonal skills.

Preferred:



Experience in object-oriented programming, preferably Java.
Experience with Gitlab, Jira & Confluence.
Experience with SQL.





OUR OFFER:   



A collaborative environment with colleagues from all over the world (Engineering offices in Europe, Asia and US) including various social events and teambuilding.
Ability to shape your own workday and career via a clearly defined professional and personal development plan.
Opportunity to develop yourself within an inspiring and fast-growing company with our Career framework possibilities.
Vibrant and inclusive community, including Women in Tech and Pride groups which welcome all participants.
Global Employee Assistance Programme.
Calm and Reulay app (managing stress, maintaining focus, improving sleep, building resilience).
Online training videos.
Flexible working hours.

For this reason, we are an office-first business operating on a hybrid model, with team members working in the office four days a week to build relationships, exchange ideas, and grow together.

Title: Data Scientist – TV-Insight
Description:
Are you passionate about creating innovative data-driven products that reshape industries?

TV-Insight is an exciting digital spin-off within Red Bull, located in Elsbethen (Austria), dedicated to revolutionizing the TV measurement and advertisement industry. As a Data Scientist, you will be at the forefront of creating and improving the analytical foundation of our novel product, capable of handling multiple millions of classification tasks every second. Working alongside a team of talented data scientists, data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders, you will play a key role in defining the success of a state-of-the-art analytics product.

All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:

Model Ownership & Production Deployment

You take ownership of the development and deployment of machine learning models for a dedicated TV-Insight market. This includes building and improving real-time machine learning applications as well as developing model components that feed into real-time projection processing. Working closely with a highly specialized team of engineers and data analysts, you ensure a strong understanding of the technical implementation while setting the highest standards for statistical modelling, creating direct business impact from day one.

Exploratory Analysis, Model Understanding & Communication

You conduct thorough exploratory data analyses to evaluate input data and gain a deep understanding of model behaviour and performance. In both research tasks and day-to-day work, you uphold best practices in modelling approaches and production-quality code. You communicate your insights in a clear and accessible way through dashboards and reports, enabling data-driven decision-making for management and key stakeholders.

Continuous Innovation & Technical Excellence

You continuously stay up to date with technological and industry developments to expand your skill set and strengthen your ability to innovate. You critically assess the potential of new methods, tools, and trends, and proactively implement your own ideas in small-scale experiments to test and validate their expected benefits before scaling them into production.

Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most for this role:


Master’s degree or PhD in a highly quantitative field such as Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
3+ years of professional experience in quantitative analytics, data science, or applied statistics.
Strong hands-on experience in statistical modelling using R or Python, with solid experience working with databases and query languages such as SQL.
Proven expertise in applying core statistical methods, including regression, classification, and hypothesis testing, to real-world business problems.
Ability to translate complex analytical results into clear, compelling visualizations and dashboards using tools such as ggplot, R Shiny, or Data Studio.
Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams.


Due to legal reasons, we are obliged to disclose the minimum salary according to the collective agreement for this position, which is € 2.362 gross per month. However, our attractive compensation package is based on market-oriented salaries and is therefore significantly above the stated minimum salary.

As an employer, we value diversity and support people in developing their potential and strengths, realizing their ideas and seizing opportunities. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, skin colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation or origin.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
HCLTech is a global technology company, home to more than 226,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services. Consolidated revenues of US $14.5B for 12 months ending December 2025




Position Overview

We are seeking a quality-focused, detail-oriented Data Scientist with a proven ability to deliver data-driven solutions that support critical business objectives and strategic decision-making. The ideal candidate is a strong analytical thinker and problem solver who can translate complex business requirements into actionable data solutions while delivering results in a fast-paced environment.




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models to support business intelligence and reporting needs.

Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable data solutions.

Map and validate data elements for ETL processes.

Optimize and maintain data models to support both new initiatives and existing systems.

Generate and support deployment of physical database structures (DDL).

Identify and resolve data integration challenges across multiple systems.

Partner with business and technical stakeholders to define requirements and recommend solutions.

Provide guidance to analysts, developers, and engineers regarding system capabilities, limitations, interfaces, and performance requirements.

Support data-driven decision-making through advanced analytics, statistical modeling, forecasting, and machine learning techniques.

Develop impactful visualizations and reports to communicate insights to technical and non-technical audiences.




Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related field.

Significant experience in Data Analytics, Data Science, or related technical roles.

Hands-on experience with data modeling tools such as Erwin and Visio.

Experience working with large datasets and enterprise analytics platforms.

Strong knowledge of data modeling, ETL processes, and data integration.

Advanced experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, R Shiny, Plotly, or D3.js.

Strong understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies.

Expertise in statistics, econometrics, forecasting, machine learning, geospatial analysis, or related analytical disciplines.

Proficiency in Python and/or R.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

Proven ability to manage priorities, facilitate discussions, and drive outcomes independently.

Strong presentation, leadership, and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.

Experience with Informatica Data Quality (IDQ) and/or Master Data Management (MDM) implementations.

Knowledge of Oracle, PL/SQL, Business Objects, Tableau, and other reporting tools.

Experience with Business Intelligence solutions and reporting frameworks.

Knowledge of ITIL, service management, and process management practices.

Familiarity with Stata, C++, MS Access, and Crystal Reports.

Experience implementing data governance, information security, and reporting solutions.

Knowledge of Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) implementations.

Experience with GIS tools such as QGIS or ArcGIS for spatial analysis.

Professional certifications such as IIBA, ITIL Foundation, or similar credentials are an advantage.




What We Look For

Strong business acumen combined with technical expertise.

Ability to influence stakeholders and drive consensus across teams.

Passion for solving complex data challenges and delivering high-quality solutions.

Strong attention to detail, accountability, and ownership from concept through delivery.




What we offer:




Food vouchers and social benefits package

Opportunity for career progression

Young and vibrant team environment

Competitive salary

Professional on-boarding and on-going trainings
